original.title: Evolutionary Blueprint Sheet for an Invention
original.prompt:
Single large horizontal blueprint sheet, 16:9 aspect ratio, showing the complete evolutionary journey of **{argument name="invention name" default="[INVENTION]"}** from its first concept to its modern form, presented as a technical blueprint coming to life.
Authentic aged blueprint paper with white technical lines on deep blue background, subtle coffee stained edges and worn paper texture. Forced perspective across the page from left to right.
Left side shows the original patent era design of **{argument name="invention name" default="[INVENTION]"}** as a pure flat 2D technical line drawing, precise drafting style, no depth. Inventor figure on the far left also drawn fully in 2D blueprint line art.
Gradual transformation across 7 to 9 clearly separated stages moving rightward: Stage 1 pure technical line drawing. Stage 2 blueprint lines beginning to lift off the page with a paper craft effect. Stage 3 partial miniature model emerging from the blueprint. Stage 4 fully formed 3D miniature model, unpainted. Stage 5 painted miniature with realistic materials. Final stage shows a photo realistic tiny working version of **{argument name="invention name" default="[INVENTION]"}**.
The inventor figure evolves in parallel from flat 2D drawing on the left into a fully 3D miniature figurine on the right, matching the same transformation stages.
Each stage labeled with technical annotations, measurement markings, arrows, and small evolution dates in blueprint drafting style typography.
Drafting tools including compass, protractor, mechanical pencil, ruler, and T square interacting with the flat blueprint areas, while the 3D sections break free from the page.
Lighting transitions from cool LED blueprint table backlight on the left to realistic practical lighting on the right, emphasizing depth and realism.
Ultra detailed technical illustration meets practical effects, high realism, clean composition, museum quality concept visualization.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Evolutionary Blueprint Sheet for an Invention
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Pédagogie : Faire comprendre une idée à la fois. Distinguer les étapes ou groupes par leur position avant d’ajouter la couleur. Garder un ordre de lecture explicite, avec des intitulés courts et suffisamment d’espace autour de chaque élément.

Exactitude visuelle : Faire correspondre chaque liaison à une relation réelle du brief. Aligner les flèches, séparer les croisements et conserver une épaisseur de trait constante. Aucun élément décoratif ne doit être pris pour une donnée.

Données et légende : Respecter les valeurs et proportions fournies ; signaler clairement les données illustratives. Ne pas inventer de chiffre manquant. Prévoir une légende simple lorsque la couleur ou un symbole porte une information.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

Proportions : Vérifier les rapports de taille entre sujet, accessoires et environnement. Les changements de profondeur expliquent les différences de taille ; éviter des éléments secondaires anormalement grands ou des détails sans épaisseur.

Cohérence chromatique : Utiliser la palette indiquée dans le brief avec des variations de valeur et de saturation. Éviter d’introduire une couleur dominante supplémentaire ; les accents servent à distinguer le sujet ou une information précise.

Qualité des contours : Adapter la netteté au médium : une limite découpée, un bord de peinture et un contour photographique ne se traitent pas de la même façon. Éviter la suraccentuation, les franges lumineuses et les doubles contours.

original.title: Educational Commodity Universe Diorama Prompt
original.prompt:
<instruction> for {argument name="commodity" default="Coffee"}

Input A is a Historic Commodity or Resource (e.g., Spices, Tea, Silk, Coffee, Gold).
Deconstruct the commodity into 3 Educational Assets:
     The Core :  Identify the most common or valuable raw form.
         (e.g., Spices -> A pile of Black Peppercorns. Tea -> A mound of Black Tea leaves. Gold -> A large Nugget). 
     The Varieties:  Identify 4-5 distinct variations or colors.
         (e.g., Spices -> Red Paprika, Yellow Turmeric, Brown Cinnamon. Tea -> Green, White, Oolong, Matcha). 
     The Transit :  Identify the historical method of transport.
         (e.g., Camel Caravans, East Indiaman Ships, Steam Trains). 

  2. Container
Goal: "Commodity Universe" Educational Diorama.
     The Base:  A large, square   Polished Walnut or Oak Board   sitting on a library table.
     The Layout:  A radial/circular design in the center, flanked by narrative vignettes in the corners.

  3. The Centerpiece
     The Metaphor:  The commodity is the center of the world.
     The Sun:  A massive, textured pile of the "Core" material (Step 1) sits in the exact center.
     The Orbit:  Inlaid gold or brass rings ripple out from the center.
     The Planets:  Smaller mounds or spheres of the "Varieties" (Step 1) orbit the center, creating a colorful spectrum of textures (powders, grains, solids).

  4. Narrative Corners 
     The Origin (Top Corners):  Miniature dioramas sculpted directly onto the board showing the harvesting process (e.g., tiny figures picking tea leaves, mining gold, or shaking spice trees).
     The Journey (Bottom Corners):  Miniature dioramas showing the "Transit" (Step 1).
         Detail:  Use   Resin   for water (ships) or   Sand   for deserts (camels).

  5. The Footer:  
     Placement:  Along the bottom edge of the board.
     Format:  Three or four rectangular   Wooden Plaques   embedded in the table.
     Content:  The name of a specific variety (e.g., "Cinnamon") engraved in serif text, with a physical sample of that ingredient piled on the plaque.

  Output:   ONE image, 1:1 Aspect Ratio, Isometric Tabletop Photography, "Museum Display" aesthetic, Warm Tones.
</instruction>

A digital illustration of a {argument name="subject" default="great white shark"} in {argument name="action/state" default="mid-hunting approach"}, portrayed with a network of glowing {argument name="primary color" default="cold bioluminescent blue"} lines mapping its {argument name="system type" default="sensory and predatory anatomy"}. The cartilaginous skeleton is rendered as flexible geometric framework, the lateral line system as a full-body motion detector array. The image is set against abyssal ocean black, depth pressure readings floating at the margins. The {argument name="area of interest" default="ampullae of Lorenzini, hundreds of electroreceptor pores clustered on the snout"}, are emphasized with a pulsing {argument name="accent color" default="red-orange"} glow, indicating {argument name="condition" default="active electromagnetic detection: the prey's heartbeat rendered as intercepted signal waves feeding into the shark's targeting consciousness"}. The teeth are visualized as serrated replacement queues. The style merges marine biology research documentation with military targeting system aesthetics, designed to resemble a naval analysis of nature's most refined predator, clinically respectful of four hundred million years of evolution.

original.title: Technical Infographic Sheet Product Specification Template
original.prompt:
Create a branded technical infographic of a [{argument name="product name" default="PRODUCT NAME"}], fully matching the visual density, structure, and engineering-style presentation of the technical food schematics of [PRODUCT NAME]with all text written in English
CRITICAL LANGUAGE RULE: Every visible word on the image must be in English.
Visual Concept
A realistic photograph or photorealistic render of the snack combined with dense technical annotation overlays, exactly like an engineering or food-packaging blueprint. Pure white studio background.
Required Technical Elements (ALL LABELED IN English)
• Labels for key product components • Internal cross-section showing structure, layers, or filling • Measurements: height, width, volume, weight (metric system) • Packaging and product material callouts with composition and quantities • Arrows indicating function, pressure, sealing, and structural integrity • Simple schematic or sectional diagram of mechanics / form / packaging • Sustainability and environmental callouts (recycling, materials, waste reduction)
Title Placement
Product name in English, bold font, inside a hand-drawn technical annotation frame (as in engineering blueprints), positioned in the upper corner.
Style & Layout
• Very high information density • Annotations feel like an engineering / architectural sketch • Black lines — 70–80% of all graphics • Accent [{argument name="brand color" default="BRAND COLOR"}] — 20–30% (arrows, key zones, headings) • The realistic product remains fully readable • Educational, food-engineering, industrial-premium aesthetic • Small brand logo in the corner (in English)
Visual Style
Minimal technical illustration aesthetic: black linework over realistic imagery, precise, highly detailed, slightly hand-drawn, like professional technical manuals.
Color Palette
White background Black text and linework [BRAND COLOR] used only for accents
Output
9:16 Vertical portrait, 8K, highly detailed,  Ultra-crisp image Social-feed optimized No watermark

Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Pédagogie : Faire comprendre une idée à la fois. Distinguer les étapes ou groupes par leur position avant d’ajouter la couleur. Garder un ordre de lecture explicite, avec des intitulés courts et suffisamment d’espace autour de chaque élément.

Exactitude visuelle : Faire correspondre chaque liaison à une relation réelle du brief. Aligner les flèches, séparer les croisements et conserver une épaisseur de trait constante. Aucun élément décoratif ne doit être pris pour une donnée.

Données et légende : Respecter les valeurs et proportions fournies ; signaler clairement les données illustratives. Ne pas inventer de chiffre manquant. Prévoir une légende simple lorsque la couleur ou un symbole porte une information.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

Proportions : Vérifier les rapports de taille entre sujet, accessoires et environnement. Les changements de profondeur expliquent les différences de taille ; éviter des éléments secondaires anormalement grands ou des détails sans épaisseur.

Cohérence chromatique : Utiliser la palette indiquée dans le brief avec des variations de valeur et de saturation. Éviter d’introduire une couleur dominante supplémentaire ; les accents servent à distinguer le sujet ou une information précise.

Qualité des contours : Adapter la netteté au médium : une limite découpée, un bord de peinture et un contour photographique ne se traitent pas de la même façon. Éviter la suraccentuation, les franges lumineuses et les doubles contours.

original.title: Premium liquid glass Bento grid product infographic with 8 modules
original.prompt:
Input Variable: [insert product name]
Language: [insert language]

System Instruction:
Create an image of premium liquid glass Bento grid product infographic with 8 modules (card 2 to 8 show text titles only).
1) Product Analysis:
→ Identify product's dominant natural color → "hero color"
→ Identify category: FOOD / MEDICINE / TECH
2) Color Palette (derived from hero):
→ Product + accents: full saturation hero color
→ Icons, borders: muted hero (30-40% saturation, never black)
3) Visual Style:
→ Hero product: real photography (authentic, premium), 3D Glass version [choose one]
→ Cards: Apple liquid glass (85-90% transparent) with Whisper-thin borders and Subtle drop shadow for floating depth and reflecting the background color
→ Background stays behind cards and high blur where cards are [choose one]:
  - Ethereal: product essence, light caustics, abstract glow
  - Macro: product texture close-up, heavily blurred
  - Pattern: product repeated softly at 10-15% opacity
  - Context: relevant environment, blurred + desaturated
→ Add subtle motion effect
→ Asymmetric Bento grid, 16:9 landscape
→ Hero card: 28-30% | Info modules: 70-72%
4) Module Content (8 Cards):
M1 — Hero: Product displayed as real photo / 3D glass / stylized interpretation (choose one)in beautiful form + product name label
M2 — Core Benefits: 4 unique benefits + hero-color icons
M3 — How to Use: 4 usage methods + icons
M4 — Key Metrics: 5 EXACT data points
Format: [icon] [Label] [Bold Value] [Unit]
FOOD: Calories: [X] kcal/100g, Carbs: [X]g (fiber [X]g, sugar [X]g), Protein: [X]g, [Key Vitamin]: [X]mg ([X]% DV), [Key Mineral]: [X]mg ([X]% DV)
MEDICINE:Active: [name], Strength: [X] mg, Onset: [X] min, Duration: [X] hrs, Half-life: [X] hrs 
TECH:Chip: [model], Battery: [X] hrs, Weight: [X]g,[Key spec]: [value], Connectivity: [protocols]
M5 — Who It's For: 4 recommended groups with green checkmark icons | 3 caution groups with amber warning icons
M6 — Important Notes: 4 precautions + warning icons
M7 — Quick Reference:
→ FOOD: Glycemic Index + dietary tags with icons
→ MEDICINE: Side effects + severity with icons
→ TECH: Compatibility + certifications with icons
M8 — Did You Know: 3 facts (origin, science, global stat) + icons
Output: 1 image, 16:9 landscape, ultra-premium liquid glass infographic.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Premium liquid glass Bento grid product infographic with 8 modules
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Pédagogie : Faire comprendre une idée à la fois. Distinguer les étapes ou groupes par leur position avant d’ajouter la couleur. Garder un ordre de lecture explicite, avec des intitulés courts et suffisamment d’espace autour de chaque élément.

Transparence : Montrer l’épaisseur aux bords, la réfraction à travers le volume et la déformation des éléments vus derrière. Les zones transparentes gardent des reflets fins ; les ombres et caustiques restent compatibles avec la direction de lumière.

Aliments : Différencier croûte, chair, glaçage ou garniture selon les aliments présents. Rendre les découpes et les couches lisibles, avec de petites irrégularités naturelles ; éviter les portions fusionnées et les textures cireuses uniformes.

Interface : Définir des groupes, alignements et états de commande cohérents. Donner plus de poids à l’action principale qu’aux informations secondaires. Le texte fourni reste lisible et les surfaces interactives ne se confondent pas avec les décorations.

Exactitude visuelle : Faire correspondre chaque liaison à une relation réelle du brief. Aligner les flèches, séparer les croisements et conserver une épaisseur de trait constante. Aucun élément décoratif ne doit être pris pour une donnée.

Données et légende : Respecter les valeurs et proportions fournies ; signaler clairement les données illustratives. Ne pas inventer de chiffre manquant. Prévoir une légende simple lorsque la couleur ou un symbole porte une information.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

original.title: Engineering Product Infographic Design
original.prompt:
Ultra-detailed technical engineering infographic, clean {argument name="background color" default="white"} background, divided into a precise {argument name="grid layout" default="2×2 grid"} by sharp black separator lines. Blueprint-style industrial design visualization featuring photorealistic 3D renders, transparent cutaways, exploded views, dimensional annotations, technical callout boxes, measurement guides, and color-coded engineering arrows (red, blue, green, orange). Professional product design presentation, Apple-style industrial design documentation, high-end technical illustration. TOP LEFT: {argument name="primary subject" default="Modern smartphone"} shown in angled perspective with display removed, exposing densely packed internal components. Visible L-shaped battery, advanced logic board, processor chip, camera module, Face ID sensors, Taptic Engine, thermal pathways, ribbon cables, screws, connectors, and cooling architecture. Precise engineering labels and dimension lines surrounding components. TOP RIGHT: Professional mirrorless camera with large zoom lens. Longitudinal cutaway through lens assembly revealing multiple glass elements, optical groups, aperture mechanism, image sensor, shutter system, electronic components, and viewfinder structure. Additional exploded sub-diagram illustrating aperture blade construction and assembly sequence. Detailed optical engineering annotations. BOTTOM LEFT: Premium wireless earbud charging case displayed partially transparent and split open. One earbud seated inside, second earbud floating above in exploded-view configuration. Internal lithium-polymer battery, miniature logic board, charging contacts, wiring channels, magnets, and compact electronic architecture clearly visible through transparent shell. Technical callouts and component identification markers. BOTTOM RIGHT: Modern mechanical keyboard with charcoal-gray keycaps and single red accent key. Horizontal transparent cutaway sections exposing mechanical switches, switch housings, springs, stabilizers, PCB circuitry, LEDs, and internal frame structure. Lower margin includes enlarged switch cross-section diagram and geometric PCB schematic blueprint. Engineering measurements and component annotations throughout. original.title: Linguistic Evolution Tree Infographic Generation
original.prompt:
<instruction>Input: language or linguistic concept ({argument name="language name" default="language name"}, writing system, or phrase). 

Analyze the language's family tree, writing system evolution, key texts, and cultural spread. 

Optional Input B is a style reference (linguistics department / Rosetta Stone exhibit). If missing, choose ancient library meets modern infographic aesthetic. 

Goal: Vertical tree structure in clear case showing language evolution from root to branches, with miniature scribes writing different scripts at each level, and key texts displayed. Rules: - Tree structure showing language family (Proto-Indo-European → Latin → Romance languages) - 8-15 scribe figurines at different branches writing in period scripts - Include miniature versions of key texts (ancient tablets, scrolls, books) - Show writing system evolution visually up the tree - Add mini maps showing geographic spread - Materials: aged parchment, clay tablets, modern paper progressing upward - Label with language name, family, speakers, writing system(s) Output: ONE image, 4:5 vertical format optimized </instruction>

original.title: Technical Infographic Prompt Template
original.prompt:
Create a technical infographic of {argument name="object" default="OBJECT"} with a 45-degree isometric 3D perspective showing the device slightly tilted to reveal depth and dimension.
Combine a realistic photoreal render with black ink technical annotations on pure white background. Include:
Key component labels with color-coded callout boxes
Internal component visibility through transparent/cutaway sections
Measurements, dimensions, and precise scale markers
Material callouts and quantities
Color-coded arrows for function/flow: RED (power/battery), BLUE (data/connectivity), ORANGE (thermal/processor), GREEN (sensors/haptics)
Simple schematics or cross-sectional diagrams where relevant

Place “OBJECT” title in a hand-drawn technical box (top-left corner).
Style: Black linework (technical pen/architectural), sketched but precise. Object remains clearly visible. Educational museum-exhibit vibe. Clean composition, balanced negative space.
Perspective: Isometric 3D angle—tilted to show depth, dimension, and internal architecture dramatically. Like a professional product teardown or engineering manual.
Colors: ~10-15% accent density. Black dominant. White background.
Output: 1080×1080, ultra-crisp, social-feed optimized.

NO

* **Result:** The bottom of every panel must be clean image data only, showing the subject fully without obstruction.

Proportions : Vérifier les rapports de taille entre sujet, accessoires et environnement. Les changements de profondeur expliquent les différences de taille ; éviter des éléments secondaires anormalement grands ou des détails sans épaisseur.

Cohérence chromatique : Utiliser la palette indiquée dans le brief avec des variations de valeur et de saturation. Éviter d’introduire une couleur dominante supplémentaire ; les accents servent à distinguer le sujet ou une information précise.

Qualité des contours : Adapter la netteté au médium : une limite découpée, un bord de peinture et un contour photographique ne se traitent pas de la même façon. Éviter la suraccentuation, les franges lumineuses et les doubles contours.

Équilibre : Répartir les masses visuelles de manière intentionnelle et laisser des espaces de respiration. Ne pas déplacer le sujet principal pour combler un vide utile ; contrôler l’image en réduction pour vérifier qu’elle reste compréhensible.

Éviter les copies mécaniques d’un même détail dans des endroits où la perspective, la matière ou le mouvement devraient le modifier.

{argument name="variation theme" default="Bare legs versus different stockings"}

YES

* **Background:** A clean, sharply defined solid rectangular color block (e.g., charcoal grey or black) spanning the entire width of the panel's bottom section.
* **Typography:** Inside this block, the text must be rendered in an **elegant, ultra-thin, minimalist sans-serif font**.
* **Layout:** The text "[Number]. [Short Title] (Prompt: [Key English Prompt Snippet])" must be perfectly centered within the color block.
* **Aesthetic:** The overall effect should be that of professional, minimalist graphic design, with crisp lines and perfect alignment.

* **Result:** The bottom of every panel must be clean image data only, showing the subject fully without obstruction.

Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Pédagogie : Faire comprendre une idée à la fois. Distinguer les étapes ou groupes par leur position avant d’ajouter la couleur. Garder un ordre de lecture explicite, avec des intitulés courts et suffisamment d’espace autour de chaque élément.

Exactitude visuelle : Faire correspondre chaque liaison à une relation réelle du brief. Aligner les flèches, séparer les croisements et conserver une épaisseur de trait constante. Aucun élément décoratif ne doit être pris pour une donnée.

Données et légende : Respecter les valeurs et proportions fournies ; signaler clairement les données illustratives. Ne pas inventer de chiffre manquant. Prévoir une légende simple lorsque la couleur ou un symbole porte une information.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

Proportions : Vérifier les rapports de taille entre sujet, accessoires et environnement. Les changements de profondeur expliquent les différences de taille ; éviter des éléments secondaires anormalement grands ou des détails sans épaisseur.

Cohérence chromatique : Utiliser la palette indiquée dans le brief avec des variations de valeur et de saturation. Éviter d’introduire une couleur dominante supplémentaire ; les accents servent à distinguer le sujet ou une information précise.

Qualité des contours : Adapter la netteté au médium : une limite découpée, un bord de peinture et un contour photographique ne se traitent pas de la même façon. Éviter la suraccentuation, les franges lumineuses et les doubles contours.

Équilibre : Répartir les masses visuelles de manière intentionnelle et laisser des espaces de respiration. Ne pas déplacer le sujet principal pour combler un vide utile ; contrôler l’image en réduction pour vérifier qu’elle reste compréhensible.

Sortie : Livrer uniquement le visuel demandé, dans le format prévu, sans cadre de présentation, interface logicielle, filigrane ou texte additionnel non demandé. Si un élément ne peut pas être déduit du brief, ne pas inventer de donnée factuelle pour le remplacer.

Priorités : Les quantités, couleurs, mots exacts, proportions et éléments imposés dans la demande initiale priment sur les conseils de finition. Résoudre les ambiguïtés avec la solution qui préserve le mieux le sujet et son intention, sans accumuler de nouveaux effets.

Lecture en réduction : Vérifier que l’idée principale se comprend lorsque l’image est affichée en petite vignette. Regrouper les détails secondaires, préserver le contraste local du point focal et éviter que les textures fines deviennent un bruit uniforme. Conserver les marges utiles autour des informations importantes.

original.prompt:
You are an expert in infographics. Read the article or report provided by the user and automatically generate a visually clear and attractive infographic that summarizes its content. Specifically, please create it considering the following elements:

### Objective
To visualize the main message, key data, process, or structure of the article or report so that it can be understood at a glance.

### Style and Tone
*   **Style**: A hand-drawn or minimal and sophisticated diagram style, similar to Napkin AI.
*   **Tone**: Professional yet approachable and visually appealing.

### Components
1.  **Title**: An attractive title that concisely represents the article's theme.
2.  **Key Points**: 3 to 5 of the most important points extracted from the entire article.
3.  **Diagrams**: Graphs, flowcharts, icons, or conceptual diagrams to represent the key points or processes.
4.  **Data**: If there are specific numbers or statistical data in the article, display them in an emphasized manner.
5.  **Conclusion/Action**: A summary of the article or the next action expected from the reader.

### Output Format
Based on the content of the provided article, output the overall image of the infographic, integrating the above components, as detailed instructions. Describe the diagram ideas, layout suggestions, and the image of the colors and fonts to be used specifically.

### Article/Report
{argument name="Content of the Article or Report" default="[Paste the full text of the article or report here]"}

entries.title: Magic Prompt for Automatic Infographic Generation with Nano Banana Pro
entries.prompt:
You are an expert in infographics. Read the article or report provided by the user and automatically generate a visually clear and attractive infographic that summarizes its content. Specifically, please create it considering the following elements:

### Objective
To visualize the main message, key data, process, or structure of the article or report so that it can be understood at a glance.

### Style and Tone
*   **Style**: A hand-drawn or minimal and sophisticated diagram style, similar to Napkin AI.
*   **Tone**: Professional yet approachable and visually appealing.

### Components
1.  **Title**: An attractive title that concisely represents the article's theme.
2.  **Key Points**: 3 to 5 of the most important points extracted from the entire article.
3.  **Diagrams**: Graphs, flowcharts, icons, or conceptual diagrams to represent the key points or processes.
4.  **Data**: If there are specific numbers or statistical data in the article, display them in an emphasized manner.
5.  **Conclusion/Action**: A summary of the article or the next action expected from the reader.

### Output Format
Based on the content of the provided article, output the overall image of the infographic, integrating the above components, as detailed instructions. Describe the diagram ideas, layout suggestions, and the image of the colors and fonts to be used specifically.

### Article/Report
{argument name="Content of the Article or Report" default="[Paste the full text of the article or report here]"}

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Magic Prompt for Automatic Infographic Generation with Nano Banana Pro

Exactitude visuelle : Faire correspondre chaque liaison à une relation réelle du brief. Aligner les flèches, séparer les croisements et conserver une épaisseur de trait constante. Aucun élément décoratif ne doit être pris pour une donnée.

Données et légende : Respecter les valeurs et proportions fournies ; signaler clairement les données illustratives. Ne pas inventer de chiffre manquant. Prévoir une légende simple lorsque la couleur ou un symbole porte une information.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

original.title: Technical Infographic Template for Objects
original.prompt:
Create a technical infographic of {argument name="object name" default="[OBJECT NAME]"} with a 45-degree isometric 3D perspective showing the device slightly tilted to reveal depth and dimension.
Combine a realistic photoreal render with black ink technical annotations on pure white background. Include:
Key component labels with color-coded callout boxes Internal component visibility through transparent/cutaway sections
Measurements, dimensions, and precise scale markers Material callouts and quantities 
Color-coded arrows for function/flow: RED (power/battery), BLUE (data/connectivity), ORANGE (thermal/processor), GREEN (sensors/haptics)
Simple schematics or cross-sectional diagrams where relevant 
Place “OBJECT NAME” title in a hand-drawn technical box (top-left corner).
Style: Black linework (technical pen/architectural), sketched but precise. Object remains clearly visible. Educational museum-exhibit vibe. Clean composition, balanced negative space.
Perspective: Isometric 3D angle—tilted to show depth, dimension, and internal architecture dramatically. Like a professional product teardown or engineering manual.
Colors: ~10–15% accent density. Black dominant. White background.
Output: 1080×1080, ultra-crisp, social-feed optimized.

original.title: Hyper-Realistic Product Photography and Infographic Prompts for Pepsi
original.prompt:
Image 1 : High-quality professional product photography of a chilled {argument name="beverage brand" default="Pepsi"} can with condensation water droplets and a refreshing, icy look. The aluminum can appears crisp and glossy with realistic highlights, subtle reflections, and visible cold texture. Shot in a minimalist commercial beverage advertising style against a pure white background with soft natural shadows. Sharp focus, ultra-clean composition, modern aesthetic.

Image 2 : Create a hyper-realistic vertical exploded infographic illustrating the ingredients of a Pepsi soft drink. At the top, clear carbonated water shown as sparkling liquid with fine rising bubbles. Below it, floating white sugar crystals with sharp crystalline texture. Below it, abstract aromatic particles symbolizing natural flavors, light and minimal. Further down, small dark caffeine granules suspended mid-air. At the bottom, a chilled blue aluminum cola can standing upright with realistic condensation droplets and metallic reflections. Pure solid white background, soft studio lighting, subtle realistic shadows under each floating layer, ultra-sharp focus, DSLR macro photography look. Clean minimalist infographic labels with thin pointer lines for each ingredient. Premium beverage advertising aesthetic, modern, photorealistic.

original.title: Infographic Prompt Template for Objects
original.prompt:
“Create an infographic image of [{argument name="object" default="OBJECT"}], combining a realistic photograph or photoreal render of the object with technical annotation overlays placed directly on top.

Use black ink–style line drawings and text (technical pen / architectural sketch look) on a pure white studio background, including:
•Key component labels
•Internal cutaway or exploded-view outlines
•Measurements, dimensions, and scale markers
•Material callouts and quantities
•Arrows indicating function, force, or flow (air, sound, power, pressure)
•Simple schematic or sectional diagrams where relevant

Place the title [OBJECT] inside a hand-drawn technical annotation box in one corner.

Style & layout rules:
•The real object remains clearly visible beneath the annotations
•Annotations feel sketched, technical, and architectural
•Clean composition with balanced negative space
•Educational, museum-exhibit / engineering-manual vibe

Visual style:
Minimal technical illustration aesthetic, black linework over realistic imagery, precise but slightly hand-drawn feel.

Color palette:
White background, black annotation lines and text only. No colors.

Output:
1080×1080, ultra-crisp, social-feed optimized, no watermark.”

original.title: Product Assembly Sequence Timeline
original.prompt:
5-stage horizontal manufacturing timeline, frozen mid-assembly. deep matte black background. dramatic industrial spotlights, deep shadow falloff.  
S1: Components scattered, floating, zero assembly. 
S2: Converging with speed lines, skeleton emerging. 
S3: Half-built, peak tension, fasteners mid-tighten. 
S4: Chassis open, full internals exposed. 
S5: Finished product + ghost wireframe overlay.

Create a hand-drawn style infographic card in a 9:16 vertical ratio. The card should have a clear theme, with a beige or off‑white paper-textured background and an overall rustic, friendly hand-drawn aesthetic.

Maintain visual balance in the overall layout and leave enough white space so the design remains clean, easy to read, and easy to understand.

original.title: Technical Infographic Overlay for Object Annotation
original.prompt:
Create an infographic image of {argument name="object" default="[OBJECT]"}, combining a realistic photograph or photorealistic rendering of the object with an overlay of technical annotations placed directly on top.
Use black ink line drawings and text (in the style of a technical pen / architectural sketch) on a clean white studio background, including:
• Labels on key components
• Internal outlines in cutaway or cross-section view
• Measurement, dimension, and scale markers
• Material and quantity designations
• Arrows indicating function, force, or flow (air, sound, power, pressure)
• Simple diagrams or cross-sections where appropriate
Place the title {argument name="object title" default="[OBJECT]"} in a box with hand-drawn technical notes in one of the corners.
Style and layout rules:
• The real object remains clearly visible under the annotations
• Annotations look schematic, technical, and architectural
• Clear composition with balanced negative space
• Educational atmosphere resembling a museum exhibition or engineering manual.
Visual style:
Minimalist technical illustration aesthetics, black lines over realistic images, crisp but slightly hand-drawn.
Color palette:
White background, only black annotation lines and text. No colors.
Output:
1080x1080 resolution, very sharp image, optimized for social media, no watermarks.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Technical Infographic Overlay for Object Annotation
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Pédagogie : Faire comprendre une idée à la fois. Distinguer les étapes ou groupes par leur position avant d’ajouter la couleur. Garder un ordre de lecture explicite, avec des intitulés courts et suffisamment d’espace autour de chaque élément.

Exactitude visuelle : Faire correspondre chaque liaison à une relation réelle du brief. Aligner les flèches, séparer les croisements et conserver une épaisseur de trait constante. Aucun élément décoratif ne doit être pris pour une donnée.

Données et légende : Respecter les valeurs et proportions fournies ; signaler clairement les données illustratives. Ne pas inventer de chiffre manquant. Prévoir une légende simple lorsque la couleur ou un symbole porte une information.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

original.title: Medical Infographic Poster for Drug Information (Bento Grid Style)
original.prompt:
{
"image_analysis": {
"subject": "{argument name="drug name" default="Semaglutide"} Science Infographic, 9:16",
"style": "Modular Bento Grid Design / Minimalist Medical UI Design / Approachable Feel",
"tone": "Professional, Clinical, Rigorous, Scientific, Trustworthy, Humanized, Easy-to-read",
"primary_colors": ["Clinical White", "Medical Blue", "Slate Grey", "Mint Green"]
},
"prompt_elements": {
"subject_description": "A high-quality science infographic poster about [Drug Name], designed to combine professional rigor with humanized care.",
"layout": "Bento box style modular grid layout, clean medical UI/UX interface design, divided into clear rectangular cards with soft edges, providing a comfortable visual experience.",
"visual_details": [
"Top header with a striking modern sans-serif font title 'Drug Chinese Name' and its chemical/generic name. A gentle medical icon (like a heart or green leaf) can be added next to the title.",
"Center top features a hyper-realistic macro photograph of the [Drug Dosage Form/Packaging] (e.g., tablet, capsule, or vial), with soft lighting, appearing safe and reliable.",
"In the corner, a minimalist line drawing of the [Chemical Structure], with smooth lines, not overly obtrusive.",
"Part 1: Analysis of active ingredients and pharmacological action with ring charts and bar charts, data visualization using gentle medical blue and mint green colors, charts designed to be simple and intuitive.",
"Part 2: Indications with minimalist line icons, icons designed to be friendly, avoiding overly clinical or cold symbols.",

original.title: Technical Infographic of an Object with Isometric 3D View
original.prompt:
“Create a technical infographic of {argument name="object" default="OBJECT"} with a 45-degree isometric 3D perspective showing the device slightly tilted to reveal depth and dimension.
Combine a realistic photoreal render with black ink technical annotations on pure white background. Include:
Key component labels with color-coded callout boxes
Internal component visibility through transparent/cutaway sections
Measurements, dimensions, and precise scale markers
Material callouts and quantities
Color-coded arrows for function/flow: RED (power/battery), BLUE (data/connectivity), ORANGE (thermal/processor), GREEN (sensors/haptics)
Simple schematics or cross-sectional diagrams where relevant

Place “OBJECT” title in a hand-drawn technical box (top-left corner).
Style: Black linework (technical pen/architectural), sketched but precise. Object remains clearly visible. Educational museum-exhibit vibe. Clean composition, balanced negative space.
Perspective: Isometric 3D angle—tilted to show depth, dimension, and internal architecture dramatically. Like a professional product teardown or engineering manual.
Colors: ~10-15% accent density. Black dominant. White background.
Output: 1080×1080, ultra-crisp, social-feed optimized.”

The milkshake has a thick creamy texture, glossy syrup dripping inside the glass, a generous swirl of whipped cream on top, fresh fruit slices, and delicate sugar sprinkles. Realistic condensation droplets cover the glass with soft reflections from the studio lights. Elegant soft lighting creates subtle natural shadows beneath the glass. Ultra-sharp focus, DSLR macro beverage photography, premium café advertisement style, hyper realistic, clean commercial composition, 8K. 

Create a hyper-realistic exploded vertical infographic composition of a premium strawberry milkshake. 
Top → Bottom structure: 
Fresh Strawberry Garnish 
→ Whipped Cream 
→ Strawberry Syrup 
→ Creamy Strawberry Shake 
→ Crushed Ice 
→ Transparent Glass Base 
All elements must be perfectly centered, evenly spaced, and vertically aligned. Show realistic strawberry texture, fluffy whipped cream, glossy syrup, thick creamy milkshake consistency, translucent ice, and realistic glass reflections. Use a soft pastel pink seamless studio background with elegant café lighting and subtle realistic shadows beneath each floating element. Ultra-sharp DSLR macro beverage photography, premium dessert drink infographic aesthetic, clean professional composition, hyper realistic, 8K. 
Add clean minimalist infographic text labels with thin pointer lines using these exact labels: 
"Strawberry" 
"Whipped Cream" 
"Strawberry Syrup" 
"Milkshake" 
"Ice" 
"Glass"

original.title: Visual Infographic of Ancient Chinese Official Ranks and Attire
original.prompt:
Create a historical diagram-style infographic, 16:9 horizontal composition, titled "Visual Deconstruction of the Ancient Chinese Official Attire Ranking System." Adopt the aesthetic of ancient canonical diagrams and draw in the style of illustrations from ancient books. The image should display a comparison of the official uniforms of nine ranks of officials from the {argument name="dynasty" default="Qing Dynasty"}, arranged from left to right by rank: nine standing figures from the first to the ninth rank. Above each figure, use fine-line painting (Gongbi) to label the "Buzi (Rank Badge) Pattern" (First Rank Crane, Second Rank Golden Pheasant, Third Rank Peacock... Ninth Rank Quail; civil officials use flying birds, military officials use fierce beasts), with a close-up magnifying glass effect highlighting the embroidery details of the Buzi. Below the figures, label the "Chaozhu (Court Bead) Material" (First Rank Eastern Pearl, Second Rank Coral, Third Rank Sapphire... decreasing by rank), "Dingdai Hualing (Hat Ornament)" (Ruby/Coral/Sapphire/Crystal, etc., distinguished by color blocks), and "Mangpao (Dragon Robe) Pattern" (Nine Dragons/Five Claws/Four Claws, using diagrams to illustrate the difference in claw count). The top of the image features a "Rank Identification Quick Reference Chart": a table comparing the differences across 5 dimensions (Buzi, Dingdai, Chaozhu, Mangpao, Waist Belt) for all 9 ranks, with each cell marked by a small icon and text. The bottom of the image features "Historical Trivia": labeling "Why civil officials used flying birds and military officials used fierce beasts" (civil service requires soaring high, military service requires bravery), "The political meaning of the Hualing" (being granted a Hualing signifies imperial favor), and "Color Restrictions" (commoners were forbidden from wearing yellow or bright yellow). The very bottom includes a timeline showing the "Evolution of Official Attire through Dynasties": thumbnail sketches illustrating the style changes from the Han, Tang, Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties. All text must be in Chinese: the top title uses the Small Seal Script font "Official Attire Rank Diagram: The Power Code Worn on the Body," and the bottom caption states "The clothing system is the visual representation of the feudal hierarchy." Use traditional official attire colors for the palette. The overall presentation should focus on historical institutions and clothing culture, suitable for historical education and cultural research.

original.title: Technical Infographic for E-commerce Product Description
original.prompt:
Create an infographic image of {argument name="object" default="Tudor North Flag"}, combining a realistic photograph or photorealistic render of the object with technical annotation overlays placed directly on top.

Use black ink–style line drawings and text (technical pen / architectural sketch look) on a pure white studio background.

Include:
•Key component labels
•Internal cutaway or exploded-view outlines (where relevant)
•Measurements, dimensions, and scale markers
•Material callouts and quantities
•Arrows indicating function, force, or flow (air, sound, power, pressure, movement)
•Simple schematic or sectional diagrams where applicable

Place the title {argument name="object title" default="[OBJECT]"} inside a hand-drawn technical annotation box in one corner.

Style & layout rules:
•The real object remains clearly visible beneath the annotations
•Annotations look hand-sketched, technical, and architectural
•Clean composition with balanced negative space
•Educational, museum-exhibit / engineering-manual vibe

Visual style:
Minimal technical illustration aesthetic.
Black linework layered over realistic imagery.
Precise but slightly hand-drawn feel.

Color palette:
Pure white background.
Black annotation lines and text only.
No colors.

Output:
Ultra-crisp
Social-feed optimized
No watermark

original.title: Encyclopedic 3D Infographic Evolution Chart
original.prompt:
Role and Subject: A massive, encyclopedic 3D infographic poster with a 16:9 ratio. Title: “THE EVOLUTION OF {argument name="product name" default="[Product Name]"}”. The visual style is a high-end fusion of museum-quality product photography and complex technical blueprints.

Core Lineup (Chronology): Arrange 8–12 historical versions of the {argument name="product name 2" default="[Product Name]"}, from the first prototype to the latest future model, completely and linearly. They are precisely positioned on a measuring scale/ruler base running horizontally across the center. Rendering: Ultra-realistic 3D, 8K resolution. Emphasize the evolution of texture: contrast the aging of the early {argument name="material atmosphere" default="[Material Atmosphere]"} with the clean, high-tech finish of the modern versions.

Brand Atmosphere (Canvas): Background: A deep, rich [Brand Color] textured background. Overlaid with watermarks of low-opacity vintage patent drawings, handwritten engineering notes, and newspaper clippings related to the brand's history. Header: A prominent, high-contrast brand logo centered at the top, with the title displayed in bold typography.

“Ultra-Dense” Information Layer (Punch Style): The layout is overwhelmed with systematized information (creating a “data aesthetic” look):
High-Density Annotation Network: Hundreds of ultra-fine white hairlines connecting specific [Key Components] (e.g., curves, buttons, engines) to compact text blocks or data tables floating in space.
Contextual Zones: “Era Modules” floating above the product. Representing different historical decades with iconographic markers.
Magnified Inserts: Circular “zoom-in” lenses scattered in empty spaces. Showing extreme macro close-ups of texture details or internal mechanisms.
Technical Specification Strip: A structured data bar placed at the bottom. Listing precise specifications (weight, dimensions, year, material code).

Technical Specifications: Octane render, Unreal Engine 5 aesthetic, editorial layout, masterpiece of information design, volumetric lighting, sharp focus, professional color grading. --ar 16:9 --v 6.0 --stylize 300 (Reference style: The history of Coca-Cola's development)

original.title: Museum-Grade 3D Diorama Poster for Historical Events
original.prompt:
Please create a museum-grade 3D isometric miniature poster for [ {argument name="event name" default="SpaceX Heavy Falcon dual booster synchronous landing"} ], first retrieving relevant information to gain knowledge.

Step 1, Intelligent Recognition and Scene Construction: First, call upon your knowledge base to determine the category of the theme I input (is it fictional literature, real historical event, sports competition, or scientific discovery). Then, accurately retrieve the specific environment, core character actions, clothing details, and atmospheric conditions when the theme occurred. In the center of the image, establish an exquisite 3D miniature scene model. The style should maintain the high-precision texture and soft lighting rendering style of Dreamworks animation. If it is sports, emphasize the explosiveness of the action and the frozen moment; if it is history, restore the sense of era and solemnity; if it is literature, emphasize the artistic conception.

Step 2, Atmosphere and Background: Discard pure white backgrounds. Use a void environment with extremely faint ink wash texture and flowing light mist, with colors automatically adjusted according to the theme, creating a high-end sense of a “historical slice” or “precious artifact.”

Step 3, Layout and Text: Generate Chinese typography centered at the bottom. The main title should be the name of the event or work, with a font design that matches the theme style. Below the title, automatically retrieve and lay out the most famous quote, commentary, date, or historical evaluation of the event, using an elegant serif font. The overall layout should be exquisitely balanced, like a high-end museum collection plaque.

- Main Title: {argument name="title" default="Creative Night."}

Minimalist ultra-high-resolution travel sketch poster of {argument name="city" default="New York City"}, on clean white sketchbook paper with subtle paper grain texture. Style: refined pen drawing + loose watercolor sketch. Delicate black ink linework, airy watercolor washes, elegant urban details. Show a {argument name="scene" default="calm everyday NYC street scene — small cafés, yellow taxis, bicycles, crosswalks, brownstone buildings, subtle local signage, fashionable pedestrians, soft morning light"}. Spacious editorial composition with generous negative space. Mood: calm, modern, sophisticated, poetic. Typography: {argument name="text" default="“[NEW YORK]” “Everyday Urban Rhythm”"} Premium travel sketch aesthetic, minimal and stylish, ultra-realistic watercolor + ink travel journal style, ultra-high-resolution, 9:16.

original.title: Monochrome Typographic Cat Illustration
original.prompt:
An artistic monochrome typographic illustration where the single word "{argument name="word" default="CAT"}" appears only once and becomes a stretching domestic cat, low in front with hindquarters slightly raised and the tail extending backward in a graceful arc. Do not repeat the word and do not add any other text. The single word must be elongated and sculpted into a fluid feline posture, with one section forming the head and front shoulders, another forming the long curved spine, and the final section extending into the tail. The image should feel elegant, flexible, and unmistakably feline. Prioritize silhouette first, anatomy second, readability third. Pure black only on white, lots of empty space, minimal poster composition. No floor scene, no fur texture, no room interior, no whiskers detail, no realism, no color.

Put the issue number and today's date in the corner along with a barcode and a price. The magazine is on a white shelf against a wall.

original.title: Brutalist Directional Blur Typography Poster Prompt

A bold experimental typographic poster in brutalist style, featuring the lowercase word ‘{argument name="word" default="design"}’ with the letters arranged in a strict 3-row by 2-column grid layout, each individual letter perfectly centered and isolated in its own square cell with equal spacing and thin invisible grid lines for structure. Soft linear gradient background from {argument name="top color" default="baby-pink"} at the top to {argument name="bottom color" default="vibrant yellow"} at the bottom. Clean minimalist composition, perfectly symmetrical grid, no additional elements, high-resolution vector aesthetic, contemporary graphic design poster with hypnotic blur dynamics.

original.title: Neo-Constructivist Typographic Brand Poster
original.prompt:
A bold Neo-Constructivist typographic brand advertisement poster for “{argument name="brand name" default="BRAND NAME"}”. The composition is a full-bleed, portrait-format graphic design piece that fuses extreme typographic-as-architecture with 2 to 3 iconic hero products of {argument name="brand name" default="BRAND NAME"} embedded directly into the layout.
The letters of “{argument name="brand name" default="BRAND NAME"}” are massively oversized, fragmented, and cropped at the edges of the frame, functioning as giant abstract geometric building blocks. The letterforms are modular, maze-like, and interlocking — constructed from rounded rectangles, angular channels, and tight negative-space gaps. The entire composition is a strict grid-structured layout divided into rectangular zones.
HERO PRODUCTS: 2 to 3 of {argument name="brand name" default="BRAND NAME"}’s most iconic, recognizable products are placed within dedicated rectangular grid zones inside the composition. The products are rendered in a flat, high-contrast, graphic illustration style — NOT photographic. They are silhouetted, simplified into bold flat shapes, and colored using only the brand’s official color palette. The products sit inside clearly defined rectangular or square cells within the grid, framed by the surrounding typographic mass. Each product occupies its own zone — one product per cell — with clean hard edges. The products feel architectural and structural, as if they are part of the typographic grid itself, not floating decorations. Examples: for Nike — a side-profile Air Max sneaker silhouette, a jersey, and a sports bag; for Coca-Cola — a glass bottle, a can, and a glass with ice; for Apple — an iPhone, MacBook, and AirPods; for McDonald’s — a burger, fries box, and a drink cup.
The products are rendered WITHOUT any background within their cell — just a flat solid brand color fill behind each product silhouette, so they integrate cleanly into the poster’s color system. Product details are reduced to essential bold outlines and flat fill areas — no gradients, no shadows, no photorealism. They should look like vintage product icons or stamp illustrations.
Color palette is strictly limited to THREE colors from {argument name="brand name" default="BRAND NAME"}’s official brand identity: {argument name="primary color" default="PRIMARY COLOR"} for the dominant typographic mass and letterforms, {argument name="accent color" default="SECONDARY COLOR"} for product silhouettes and the single bold geometric accent shape (a perfect circle or bold stripe), and {argument name="background color" default="BACKGROUND COLOR"} as the deep solid background. All fills are 100% flat. No gradients, no tints, no textures on the products themselves.
Somewhere along the left or right vertical edge, the brand name “{argument name="brand name" default="BRAND NAME"}” is typeset in large, bold, condensed sans-serif capital letters rotated 90 degrees in the accent color, anchoring the composition as a vertical label. At least one perfect geometric circle in the accent color appears in the upper zone of the composition as a structural element.
The overall aesthetic references Soviet Constructivism (Rodchenko, El Lissitzky), 1970s Swiss Internat

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Neo-Constructivist Typographic Brand Poster
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Composition éditoriale : Organiser l’image en trois niveaux : titre, visuel principal, informations secondaires si elles sont fournies. Préserver de vraies marges et des espaces calmes ; les éléments décoratifs ne doivent pas rivaliser avec le message.

Géométrie : Hiérarchiser quelques formes simples, avec des angles et proportions cohérents. Réserver les petites facettes ou les accents géométriques au point focal ; ne pas multiplier les subdivisions sans améliorer la lecture.

Hiérarchie éditoriale : Faire lire d’abord le titre exact demandé, puis le sujet, puis les informations secondaires prévues. Préserver les bords de coupe et les espaces de respiration. Éviter les faux crédits, les dates ou les logos ajoutés automatiquement.

Signe et reproduction : Faire fonctionner la silhouette à petite taille, avec des contreformes dégagées et des espacements réguliers. Si le signe devient un objet, conserver sa géométrie et montrer sa matière sans ajouter de détails qui en changent la lecture.

Typographie : Composer les mots exacts demandés, avec accents, ponctuation et espacement régulier. Éviter les lettres fusionnées ou tronquées. Garder des blocs lisibles et limiter le nombre de familles typographiques au nécessaire.

Support : Adapter les traces d’impression au style choisi : grain, encrage ou léger décalage restent subtils et localisés. La texture du papier ne doit pas dégrader la lisibilité des lettres ni masquer le sujet.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

Proportions : Vérifier les rapports de taille entre sujet, accessoires et environnement. Les changements de profondeur expliquent les différences de taille ; éviter des éléments secondaires anormalement grands ou des détails sans épaisseur.

Cohérence chromatique : Utiliser la palette indiquée dans le brief avec des variations de valeur et de saturation. Éviter d’introduire une couleur dominante supplémentaire ; les accents servent à distinguer le sujet ou une information précise.

Qualité des contours : Adapter la netteté au médium : une limite découpée, un bord de peinture et un contour photographique ne se traitent pas de la même façon. Éviter la suraccentuation, les franges lumineuses et les doubles contours.

Équilibre : Répartir les masses visuelles de manière intentionnelle et laisser des espaces de respiration. Ne pas déplacer le sujet principal pour combler un vide utile ; contrôler l’image en réduction pour vérifier qu’elle reste compréhensible.

Sortie : Livrer uniquement le visuel demandé, dans le format prévu, sans cadre de présentation, interface logicielle, filigrane ou texte additionnel non demandé. Si un élément ne peut pas être déduit du brief, ne pas inventer de donnée factuelle pour le remplacer.

original.title: Premium Japanese-Style Kiwi Juice Skin Packaging Poster
original.prompt:
Premium Japanese-style product poster in 16:9 landscape format, editorial design showcasing kiwi juice skin packaging concept with sophisticated visual storytelling:

LEFT SIDE (40% of canvas):
- Hero product: One large kiwi juice skin package displayed vertically with dramatic soft lighting, showing ultra-realistic kiwi peel texture wrapped around rectangular container, fuzzy brown skin with thousands of fine visible hair-like fibers covering entire surface, rough natural texture, brown color with subtle variations, looks exactly like real kiwi skin stretched over package
- Below: One cross-sectioned fresh kiwi showing vibrant green creamy flesh with black seeds radiating from white center
- Japanese typography vertically aligned: "キウイスキン" (Kiwi Skin) in elegant thin gothic font
- Subtitle: "Fruit Juice Skin / Kiwi" in refined style
- Small design philosophy text in Japanese

CENTER (30% of canvas):
- Generous white negative space (Ma - 間)
- Minimal geometric elements: delicate thin lines
- Floating text: "自然な素材" (natural materials)
- Subtle minimalist brand mark
- Very subtle kiwi fuzz texture pattern in background (low opacity)

RIGHT SIDE (30% of canvas):
- Two kiwi juice skin packages arranged artistically at different angles and heights
- One whole fresh kiwi with natural fuzzy brown skin
- Typography: "Natural Packaging / 自然な包装"
- Tagline: "The skin is the package / 皮膚が包装である"
- Detail callouts pointing to fuzzy hair texture

DESIGN PRINCIPLES: Abundant white space, asymmetrical balance, Wabi-sabi aesthetic, Muji/Noritake editorial minimalism
COLOR PALETTE: brown kiwi tones, pure white background, bright green accent from flesh
PHOTOGRAPHY: Soft diffused studio lighting, ultra-sharp macro details showing fuzzy texture, photorealistic rendering
CRITICAL: The kiwi skin packaging must look incredibly realistic - actual organic fuzzy brown texture with thousands of tiny brown hairs, rough natural appearance, NOT plastic

The legs break dramatically through the bottom edge of the clean frame, extending into the foreground on the grainy [OUTER_PAPER_COLOR] paper surface. One leg is bent with the foot resting firmly right on the bottom ledge of the inner frame, while the left leg is dramatically closer to the camera, creating an extreme 3D pop-out effect with realistic low-angle foreshortening.

- Masculine facial expression only: calm, confident, stoic, slightly intense
- No smiling, no playful or cute expressions
- Strong jaw presence and grounded masculinity
- Editorial “bad boy” attitude, controlled and confident

POSTER LAYOUT (STRICT):
- EXACT 3x3 grid (9 panels only)
- Perfect symmetry, equal panel size
- Consistent framing and crop
- Neutral studio background
- Luxury men’s fashion editorial layout

- All poses must read MANLY and STRONG
- Strong neck posture and jaw angles
- Subtle head turns, chin forward or slightly down
- Natural masculine hand poses allowed:
  - Hand near jaw or chin
  - Fingers touching neck or collarbone
  - Hand brushing hair back
  - Relaxed hand near face
- No soft wrist bends, no feminine gestures
- Poses should feel dynamic, confident, rebellious

BAD BOY ENERGY:
- Calm but dangerous confidence
- Slight intensity in eyes
- Editorial “don’t-care but powerful” presence
- Masculine K-Pop idol bad boy aesthetic

ACCESSORIES (MANDATORY):
- Diamond stud earrings in EVERY panel
- Earrings must be small, clean, masculine, high-end
- Some panels may include:
  - Classic aesthetic reading glasses
  - Stylish black sunglasses
- Accessories must enhance masculinity, not distract

MAKEUP & GROOMING (VERY IMPORTANT):
- Sophisticated masculine elegance
- Sharp jawline definition
- Pristine, absolutely flawless realistic skin texture
- High-end fashion editorial grooming
- Matte-finish skin: zero shine, zero oil, zero sweat
- Imperceptible pores, ultra-clean complexion
- Very subtle, undetectable corrective grooming
- Enhances bone structure naturally without visible makeup
- Ultimate freshness and health despite movement
- Neutral, hydrated matte lips
- Neat, masculine eyebrows (not overstyled)

HAIRSTYLES TO APPLY:

SHORT HAIR:
1. Buzz Cut Korean (strong frontal bad-boy pose)

3. Short Two Block Perm (structured, confident masculinity)

MEDIUM HAIR:
4. Comma Hair (controlled bad-boy elegance)
5. Messy Korean Medium Perm (rugged, textured energy)
6. Braids (bold, masculine, fashion-forward)

LONG HAIR:
7. High Bun Soft Korean Perm (warrior-like posture)
8. Wolf Cut (rebellious, edgy male fashion)
9. Long Wavy Choppy Hair (rockstar bad-boy masculinity)

HAIR REALISM RULES:
- Ultra-photorealistic hair texture
- Natural masculine hair density
- No beauty-gloss finish
- Hair moves naturally with head and hand gestures
- Realistic hairline adjustments only

PHOTOGRAPHY & FASHION STYLE:
- MEN’S high-fashion editorial photoshoot
- Masculine lighting with soft contrast
- Shadows enhance jaw, cheekbones, and neck
- Korean luxury men’s magazine aesthetic
- Bold, confident, fashion-forward mood

original.prompt:
Please design a high-quality 3D poster for the film/novel "{argument name="name" default="Name to be added"}", requiring prior retrieval of information about the film/novel and famous scene clips. First, use your knowledge base to retrieve the content of this film/novel and find the most representative famous scene or core location. In the center of the image, construct this scene as an exquisite isometric 3D miniature model.

The style should adopt the delicate, soft rendering style of Dreamworks animation. You need to restore the architectural details, character dynamics, and environmental atmosphere of the time; whether it's a storm or a tranquil afternoon, it should naturally blend into the model's lighting and shadows. Regarding the background, do not use a simple pure white base. Please create a void environment around the model with faint ink wash blending and flowing light mist, with elegant color tones, making the image appear breathable and deep, highlighting the preciousness of the central model.

Finally, for the layout at the bottom, generate Chinese text. Center the name of the novel, with a font design that matches the style of the original work. Below the title, automatically retrieve and lay out a classic description or line from the original work related to that scene, using an elegant serif font. The overall layout should be exquisitely balanced, like a high-end museum collection plaque.

A detailed paragraph prompt for copy-pasting would describe a high-resolution, full-body vertical fashion magazine cover titled "EMA'Z," rendered in metallic gold serif text. Below the title, smaller text indicates "JUNE 2026 ISSUE." The central image is a dynamic, full-body photo of model {argument name="model" default="Arden Cho"}, suspended in a powerful, airborne jumping pose with her left leg bent and her right arm on her hip. She has wild, wind-blown black hair, clear, focused eyes (without an eye-band), and is looking directly at the viewer. She wears a new, form-fitting, sleeveless turtlneck crop top in a {argument name="fabric" default="rich emerald-green satin"} fabric, replacing the previous blue top. She is wearing dark-wash denim jeans with the specific denim rose floral belt from the original. A flowing, long, sheer gold fabric scarf-like accessory billows around her head. The background is a clean, creamy paper texture. On the left side, stacked gold serif text reads: 'GOLD STANDARD THE ULTIMATE GUIDE TO LUXURY SHOPPING' and below it, 'COSTUME DRAMA: REDEFINING THE RED CARPET'. On the right side, corresponding text reads: '2026' in large gold numerals, and below it, 'KEY ESSENTIALS FOR THE MODERN WARDROBE!'. At the very bottom of the cover, large gold serif text proclaims: 'GREEN' with 'REVOLUTION?' below it, and 'IS SUSTAINABLE LUXURY POSSIBLE?' in smaller gold text at the base. A clear barcode is in the bottom-left corner. The overall aesthetic is cohesive, professional, and elegant.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Emerald Green Fashion Magazine Cover
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Composition éditoriale : Organiser l’image en trois niveaux : titre, visuel principal, informations secondaires si elles sont fournies. Préserver de vraies marges et des espaces calmes ; les éléments décoratifs ne doivent pas rivaliser avec le message.

Hiérarchie éditoriale : Faire lire d’abord le titre exact demandé, puis le sujet, puis les informations secondaires prévues. Préserver les bords de coupe et les espaces de respiration. Éviter les faux crédits, les dates ou les logos ajoutés automatiquement.

Typographie : Composer les mots exacts demandés, avec accents, ponctuation et espacement régulier. Éviter les lettres fusionnées ou tronquées. Garder des blocs lisibles et limiter le nombre de familles typographiques au nécessaire.

Support : Adapter les traces d’impression au style choisi : grain, encrage ou léger décalage restent subtils et localisés. La texture du papier ne doit pas dégrader la lisibilité des lettres ni masquer le sujet.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

original.title: Creative Poster with Cutout Portrait and Chalkboard Doodles
original.prompt:
{
  "image_generation_prompt": "A modern creative poster aesthetic featuring a realistic photographic portrait of a young woman in side profile. She is wearing white over-ear headphones, her hair is in a loose bun, and she is dressed in a dark denim jacket. The subject is rendered as a cutout with a thick white outline sticker effect. The background is a flat, solid teal-green canvas covered in white hand-drawn chalkboard-style doodles. Doodles include musical notes flowing like sound waves, planets, rockets, stars, moons, arrows, crowns, and hearts. Interspersed handwritten typography includes the words 'CREATE', 'DREAM', 'IMAGINE', 'EXPLORE', and 'FLOW'. The composition is a whimsical mix of realistic photography and clean graphic design with an imaginative, dreamy mood."
}

original.title: Editorial Poster for Hari Pers Nasional 2026
original.prompt:
Ultra-realistic official editorial poster for Hari Pers Nasional 2026, dignified, human-centered, and authoritative.

A close-up formal portrait of an Indonesian female journalist portrayed as a refined female cyborg, representing the balanced integration of human conscience and advanced technology in national journalism.

Her expression is calm, firm, and full of empathy, reflecting integrity, responsibility, and commitment to truth.
Her gaze is steady and composed behind elegant rose-gold tinted cat-eye sunglasses with subtle reflective lenses, conveying clarity and credibility.
Her long silver-white hair is styled in a neat, elegant high ponytail, orderly and controlled, with minimal soft strands framing the face. No wind, no dramatic motion — formal editorial portrait.

Subtle signs of professional fatigue blend with quiet dignity, symbolizing dedication and service.
 Restrained, refined cybernetic detailing on the neck and shoulders integrates seamlessly with natural human skin, conveying technological advancement with ethical restraint.

She holds a simple pen close to her chest, softly illuminated, symbolizing integrity, conscience, and responsibility of the press.
Background: softly blurred with shallow depth of field, featuring understated newspaper headlines, archival press imagery, and minimal digital light accents — secondary, subdued, and respectful.

Lighting: warm, soft, and controlled. Natural key light highlights the face with gentle contrast, formal editorial lighting suitable for official publications.

Typography (mandatory, clear, and formal):
Classic editorial serif typeface inspired by newspaper and state publications. High-contrast white or light gray text on a darker background, clean alignment, official layout.

Printed text on poster (must be clearly legible):

“Selamat Hari Pers Nasional 2026”
“Di tengah disrupsi digital, mari kita dukung pers yang sehat untuk mencerdaskan bangsa dan menjaga kedaulatan informasi.”

“Pers Sehat, Ekonomi Berdaulat, Bangsa Kuat.”

Small formal editorial credit at the bottom corner (sharp and readable):
 “didesain oleh promptverse”

Ultra-high resolution, static and symmetrical composition, calm authority, respectful national tone.
Appropriate for official government, institutional, and national commemorative media.

🔧 Optional Negative Prompt

dynamic pose, wind-blown hair, exaggerated cyberpunk style, chaotic lighting,
aggressive expression, action scene, messy composition, unreadable text,
distorted typography, blur, dramatic effects
#haripersnasional #HPN2026

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Editorial Poster for Hari Pers Nasional 2026
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Composition éditoriale : Organiser l’image en trois niveaux : titre, visuel principal, informations secondaires si elles sont fournies. Préserver de vraies marges et des espaces calmes ; les éléments décoratifs ne doivent pas rivaliser avec le message.

Hiérarchie éditoriale : Faire lire d’abord le titre exact demandé, puis le sujet, puis les informations secondaires prévues. Préserver les bords de coupe et les espaces de respiration. Éviter les faux crédits, les dates ou les logos ajoutés automatiquement.

Typographie : Composer les mots exacts demandés, avec accents, ponctuation et espacement régulier. Éviter les lettres fusionnées ou tronquées. Garder des blocs lisibles et limiter le nombre de familles typographiques au nécessaire.

Support : Adapter les traces d’impression au style choisi : grain, encrage ou léger décalage restent subtils et localisés. La texture du papier ne doit pas dégrader la lisibilité des lettres ni masquer le sujet.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

Proportions : Vérifier les rapports de taille entre sujet, accessoires et environnement. Les changements de profondeur expliquent les différences de taille ; éviter des éléments secondaires anormalement grands ou des détails sans épaisseur.

Cohérence chromatique : Utiliser la palette indiquée dans le brief avec des variations de valeur et de saturation. Éviter d’introduire une couleur dominante supplémentaire ; les accents servent à distinguer le sujet ou une information précise.

Qualité des contours : Adapter la netteté au médium : une limite découpée, un bord de peinture et un contour photographique ne se traitent pas de la même façon. Éviter la suraccentuation, les franges lumineuses et les doubles contours.

Équilibre : Répartir les masses visuelles de manière intentionnelle et laisser des espaces de respiration. Ne pas déplacer le sujet principal pour combler un vide utile ; contrôler l’image en réduction pour vérifier qu’elle reste compréhensible.

Ultra-realistic rendering

original.title: Streetwear Editorial Fashion Poster
original.prompt:
Create a high-fashion streetwear editorial poster featuring a stylish {argument name="ethnicity" default="Korean woman"} (early 20s) with a confident, powerful attitude. She is standing in a relaxed, dominant pose with hands in pockets, looking directly at the camera with a calm, fearless expression. She is wearing modern urban streetwear: oversized varsity or bomber jacket, cropped top, baggy cargo pants, and chunky sneakers. The outfit should feel premium, trendy, and runway-inspired. The background is a bold, graphic design in a {argument name="color theme" default="deep purple"} aesthetic with large oversized typography reading “{argument name="text" default="RULE BREAKER"}” or similar motivational street-style text. Add layered collage elements like torn paper textures, stickers, scribbles, stamps, barcode graphics, and handwritten motivational phrases such as “BE LIMITLESS”, “NO RULES”, “STAY BOLD”. Lighting should be studio-quality with soft shadows, fashion editorial style, ultra-sharp details, and high contrast. The composition should feel like a modern magazine cover / streetwear brand campaign, combining luxury fashion with rebellious street culture. Color theme: purple, white, black accents, with subtle grunge texture. Ultra-realistic, 8K, high detail, fashion photography, editorial composition, centered framing, full-body shot, cinematic clarity. Aspect ratio: 4:5

original.title: Tactile Risograph Studio Poster
original.prompt:
A highly detailed, tactile flat-lay photograph of a {argument name="poster subject" default="neo-analog advertisement poster for "RISO RIOT Print Studio.""} The poster embodies an 'imperfect humanism' aesthetic, printed on {argument name="paper type" default="heavy, rough-textured cream-colored recycled paper with visible fiber grain"}, lying flat on a worn wooden studio table under soft, natural window light. The composition features a vibrant, slightly misregistered risograph print using limited colors: fluorescent pink, school bus yellow, and electric blue. The artwork consists of bold, abstract, overlapping geometric shapes and forms, showing deliberate ink bleed and slight offset misalignments where colors meet, creating a raw, hands-on feel.

Chunky, imperfect hand-drawn typography dominates the layout, reading "{argument name="text content" default="PRINT SOMETHING REAL"}" in thick, wobbly letterforms using a smudged black riso ink effect. The studio name "RISO RIOT Print Studio" is integrated into the freeform, anti-grid composition using smaller, similarly rough, stamped-style text. The overall design has a spontaneous, naïve quality, featuring visible torn paper collage elements and rough rubber stamp texture overlays. The focus is sharp on the deeply tactile, slightly grainy surface of the paper and the imperfect application of the vibrant, transparent inks.

original.title: Vertical Birthday Poster Collage with Cinematic Monochrome Photos
original.prompt:
A vertical birthday poster collage. The background features four stacked horizontal rounded rectangles, each containing monochrome cinematic photographs of a young girl with curly hair and sunglasses in various poses. Superimposed on the left foreground is a high-resolution, full-color cutout of the same girl wearing an unbuttoned pink mauve shirt and sunglasses, in a cool pose, with a thick white sticker-style outline.

original.title: Culinary Poster with Split Photo/Illustration Design

Clean contemporary square culinary poster featuring {argument name="food item" default="Christmas pudding"} against a flat {argument name="background color" default="red"} backdrop. The second half transforms into a minimal outline illustration that mirrors the identical shape and key features of the photographed side, keeping consistent scale and viewing angle.
