Generous blank space throughout, uniform background tone, balanced diffused studio brightness, minimal shadow presence, contemporary commercial design style, human-free, object-focused composition.

A pair of vintage-style travel poster illustrations by A. Moreau, featuring a whimsical, hand-drawn {argument name="style" default="watercolor aesthetic"} with crisp ink outlines. The first scene depicts a charming {argument name="first location" default="Swiss alpine village"} street lined with traditional wooden chalets, flower-filled window boxes, a "Café des Cimes," a Bernese Mountain Dog, and a yellow vintage PostAuto bus, all set against a majestic backdrop of snow-capped mountains. The second scene captures a vibrant {argument name="second location" default="Parisian street in Montmartre"} with colorful Haussmann-style buildings, a "Café des Artistes," a French Bulldog, a classic green tram on cobblestone tracks, and the Eiffel Tower rising in the background. Both illustrations include diverse crowds of locals and tourists enjoying the scenery, dressed in classic casual attire, complete with stylized cursive and serif typography at the top celebrating each destination's unique character.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Vintage Watercolor Travel Posters
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Composition éditoriale : Organiser l’image en trois niveaux : titre, visuel principal, informations secondaires si elles sont fournies. Préserver de vraies marges et des espaces calmes ; les éléments décoratifs ne doivent pas rivaliser avec le message.

Pigments et eau : Alterner lavis transparents, bords diffus et quelques contours plus nets. Montrer de légères accumulations de pigment et réserver le blanc du papier pour les lumières ; éviter un flou uniforme qui efface le dessin.

Hiérarchie éditoriale : Faire lire d’abord le titre exact demandé, puis le sujet, puis les informations secondaires prévues. Préserver les bords de coupe et les espaces de respiration. Éviter les faux crédits, les dates ou les logos ajoutés automatiquement.

Caractère analogique : Adapter le grain, les couleurs et les petites imperfections au procédé demandé. Les défauts restent mesurés et ne doivent pas effacer le sujet ; éviter les poussières, rayures et fuites de lumière ajoutées partout sans logique.
entries.tags: Affiches & édition Vintage Watercolor Travel Posters A prompt for creating whimsical, hand-drawn watercolor travel illustrations of European cities like Swiss alpine villages or Montmartre in Paris.

original.title: 2026 Year of the Horse Poster Design Prompt
original.prompt:
This image is an eye-catching promotional poster, sized 957x1278 pixels, designed to be luxurious and vibrant, predominantly in gold tones with a dark background. In the center of the poster is a meticulously designed geometric horse running from the right side towards the camera on the left. It is constructed from multi-faceted cut gold and crystal-like surfaces, radiating light and energy, as if galloping forward. The horse's form is modern and abstract, composed of sharp, reflective polygons that reflect light, creating a sense of dynamism and brilliance. At the top, the striking gold Chinese characters “{argument name="Chinese blessing" default="2026 Success Comes Immediately"}” (font style: Founder Ziji - Longyin Ti) are visible, with smaller English text “{argument name="English blessing" default="Happy New Year"}” above it. Below the horse, a shimmering golden wave flows, adorned with sparkling particles and glowing spheres. The overall aesthetic conveys power, innovation, and optimism, symbolizing success and forward momentum in the new year.

The bottom right features the text, 'DESERT BLOSSOM: Finding New Forms,' with the sub-headline 'A Journey Through Textures and Light.'
​This captivating cover captures the essence of artistic exploration and the beauty found within diverse cultural contexts.

original.title: Gritty Monochrome Music Poster Prompt with Neon Accents
original.prompt:
Create a bold, high-energy vertical music poster featuring a young female singer performing live on stage. She is captured mid-performance, holding a microphone close to her mouth, smiling with confidence and charisma. Her hair is styled in messy space buns with loose strands, and she wears an oversized black t-shirt layered with chunky chain necklaces, giving a rebellious, effortless stage presence. The portrait is treated in gritty monochrome with subtle grain and texture, while neon green accents are painted over parts of the image—especially flame-like graphic shapes rising from the bottom of her shirt—adding intensity and visual punch. The background is a flat, textured teal-green surface with visible noise and poster grain. Dominating the composition behind the subject is oversized, rounded, bold yellow typography spelling out "{argument name="text" default="ROCK STAR"}" in stacked lines. The letters are thick, playful, and slightly retro, filling most of the frame and partially obscured by the performer to create depth. Place her name behind the figure.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Gritty Monochrome Music Poster Prompt with Neon Accents
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Composition éditoriale : Organiser l’image en trois niveaux : titre, visuel principal, informations secondaires si elles sont fournies. Préserver de vraies marges et des espaces calmes ; les éléments décoratifs ne doivent pas rivaliser avec le message.

Reflets métalliques : Dessiner des reflets continus qui épousent la courbure, avec des transitions franches entre clair et sombre. Éviter une surface grise uniforme : la lecture du métal vient du reflet de l’environnement et de bords bien définis.

Hiérarchie éditoriale : Faire lire d’abord le titre exact demandé, puis le sujet, puis les informations secondaires prévues. Préserver les bords de coupe et les espaces de respiration. Éviter les faux crédits, les dates ou les logos ajoutés automatiquement.

Sources colorées : Attribuer à chaque teinte lumineuse une provenance identifiable. Garder les hautes lumières maîtrisées et des zones sombres lisibles ; le glow reste proche des sources et ne doit pas recouvrir tous les contours.

original.prompt:

The artwork features a bustling, historic street scene filled with people, a {argument name="subject" default="couple walking a Shiba Inu dog"} in the foreground, and patrons sitting outside a cafe. The text at the top reads "A JOURNEY through HIDDEN LANES & CHARACTER" in elegant typography.

original.title: Futuristic Neo-Illustration Poster
original.prompt:
Ultra-detailed neo-futuristic illustration style fused with expressive {argument name="aesthetic" default="vintage character engraving aesthetics"}. Bold {argument name="design" default="cyberpunk streetwear"} design rendered using sharp vector-like silhouettes, clean geometric contouring, and high-contrast cel-shaded lighting combined with organic painterly facial detailing. Strong Japanese graphic-poster influence with oversized typography blocks, abstract kanji elements, urban decals, and minimal industrial background compositions. Dominant palette of {argument name="colors" default="deep matte black, off-white, muted sepia, and aggressive neon red accents"} creating a striking editorial contrast. Facial rendering uses carved woodcut-inspired planes, dramatic wrinkle topology, angular anatomy lines, and flowing hand-illustrated beard/hair strands with subtle inked texture. Clothing and mechanical accessories feature layered techwear details, modular panels, patches, straps, cables, and futuristic industrial design language. Brushwork alternates between crisp hard-edge graphic fills and textured painterly shading with visible handcrafted imperfections. Overall aesthetic feels like a fusion of cyberpunk anime poster art, retro propaganda graphics, graphic novel illustration, ukiyo-e inspired line simplification, and cinematic concept-art portraiture with bold visual storytelling energy.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Futuristic Neo-Illustration Poster
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Composition éditoriale : Organiser l’image en trois niveaux : titre, visuel principal, informations secondaires si elles sont fournies. Préserver de vraies marges et des espaces calmes ; les éléments décoratifs ne doivent pas rivaliser avec le message.

Hiérarchie éditoriale : Faire lire d’abord le titre exact demandé, puis le sujet, puis les informations secondaires prévues. Préserver les bords de coupe et les espaces de respiration. Éviter les faux crédits, les dates ou les logos ajoutés automatiquement.

Typographie : Composer les mots exacts demandés, avec accents, ponctuation et espacement régulier. Éviter les lettres fusionnées ou tronquées. Garder des blocs lisibles et limiter le nombre de familles typographiques au nécessaire.

Support : Adapter les traces d’impression au style choisi : grain, encrage ou léger décalage restent subtils et localisés. La texture du papier ne doit pas dégrader la lisibilité des lettres ni masquer le sujet.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

original.title: City Ribbon Poster Design Prompt
original.prompt:
A silk ribbon unfurls diagonally across the canvas, twisting gently in mid-air. Within the folds of the ribbon exists a miniature sculpted city of {argument name="city" default="[CITY]"}, carved as a 3D bas-relief emerging from woven fabric textures.

Inside the ribbon: Landmarks, streets, and skyline rhythms of {argument name="city" default="[CITY]"}, flowing naturally with the ribbon’s curvature, layered in subtle depth.

Style: Fabric realism fused with sculptural relief. Soft highlights, tactile folds, elegant poster design.

Color palette: Derived from the national flag of {argument name="country" default="[COUNTRY]"}, woven seamlessly into the fabric tones.

CRITICAL: Every element must appear as hand-embroidered with visible, realistic stitching details. Show individual thread stitches, slight texture variations, and authentic embroidery craftsmanship.

Visual Structure: 
- Delicate high-end silk fabric background with subtle sheen and fine weave texture, {argument name="color scheme" default="[Color Scheme]"}, occupying 75% of canvas.
- Scene Visualization: A simplified, poetic scene of {argument name="scene description" default="[Scene Description]"}, rendered in hand-embroidered silk with VISIBLE REALISTIC STITCHING DETAILS.
- Scale Contrast: Tiny, barely visible silhouettes of [Detail Elements] at the bottom/corners.

Base: Luxurious silk fabric background with subtle sheen, fine weave texture, and soft luminous quality.

HAND-EMBROIDERY DETAILS: Every element must show:
- Individual visible thread stitches with slight texture
- Microscopic silk thread details with subtle metallic sheen
- Realistic embroidery craftsmanship with slightly imperfect, organic stitching
- Visible stitch patterns and thread texture variations
- Authentic hand-embroidered appearance with natural imperfections
The scene features soft muted colors (pale [Color] for the [Element], muted [Color] for the [Element], soft [Color] for the [Element]). Realism: Extreme dimensional depth, realistic hand-embroidered stitches, tactile silk texture with visible stitch details.

Color Palette: Subtle high-end [Main Color] silk background. Soft muted colors for the scene (pale [Color], muted [Color], soft [Color]). Elegant, refined, and sophisticated mood.

Typography: 
- Top title "[Song Title]" in minimalist elegant serif typography (hand-embroidered in subtle thread), surrounded by maximum breathing space.
- Subtitle "[Artist] • [Year] • [Genre]" in refined font.
- Small bilingual text "[English Keyword] [Chinese Keyword]" in refined font.

CRITICAL - BOTTOM DESIGN: The text must show OBVIOUS hand-embroidered style with:
- Spacing between individual stitches visible
- Organic, slightly imperfect stitch patterns
- Natural texture variations in the thread
- Hand-stitched appearance rather than dense machine embroidery
- Clear manual embroidery craftsmanship

Bottom Design: Elegant flow of musical notes intertwined with refined calligraphy showcasing TWO COHESIVE, NARRATIVE-FULL lyrics from the song:
Line 1: "{argument name="first lyric line" default="[First Lyric Line]"}"\nLine 2: "{argument name="second lyric line" default="[Second Lyric Line]"}"\nRendered in elegant [Calligraphy Style] style calligraphy with refined strokes, all hand-embroidered with VISIBLE INDIVIDUAL STITCHES. Embroidered in [Main Thread Color] and [Accent Thread Color] threads, connecting notes and text with delicate [Line Type] lines, showing OBVIOUS hand-embroidered texture with individual stitch visibility.

Border: Minimal single thin line border in [Border Color] (hand-embroidered). Corner: One small elegant [Symbol] symbol (hand-stitched

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Futuristic New Year Magazine Cover Design Prompt
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Composition éditoriale : Organiser l’image en trois niveaux : titre, visuel principal, informations secondaires si elles sont fournies. Préserver de vraies marges et des espaces calmes ; les éléments décoratifs ne doivent pas rivaliser avec le message.

Hiérarchie éditoriale : Faire lire d’abord le titre exact demandé, puis le sujet, puis les informations secondaires prévues. Préserver les bords de coupe et les espaces de respiration. Éviter les faux crédits, les dates ou les logos ajoutés automatiquement.

Typographie : Composer les mots exacts demandés, avec accents, ponctuation et espacement régulier. Éviter les lettres fusionnées ou tronquées. Garder des blocs lisibles et limiter le nombre de familles typographiques au nécessaire.

Support : Adapter les traces d’impression au style choisi : grain, encrage ou léger décalage restent subtils et localisés. La texture du papier ne doit pas dégrader la lisibilité des lettres ni masquer le sujet.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

Proportions : Vérifier les rapports de taille entre sujet, accessoires et environnement. Les changements de profondeur expliquent les différences de taille ; éviter des éléments secondaires anormalement grands ou des détails sans épaisseur.

Cohérence chromatique : Utiliser la palette indiquée dans le brief avec des variations de valeur et de saturation. Éviter d’introduire une couleur dominante supplémentaire ; les accents servent à distinguer le sujet ou une information précise.

Équilibre : Répartir les masses visuelles de manière intentionnelle et laisser des espaces de respiration. Ne pas déplacer le sujet principal pour combler un vide utile ; contrôler l’image en réduction pour vérifier qu’elle reste compréhensible.

Sortie : Livrer uniquement le visuel demandé, dans le format prévu, sans cadre de présentation, interface logicielle, filigrane ou texte additionnel non demandé. Si un élément ne peut pas être déduit du brief, ne pas inventer de donnée factuelle pour le remplacer.

Priorités : Les quantités, couleurs, mots exacts, proportions et éléments imposés dans la demande initiale priment sur les conseils de finition. Résoudre les ambiguïtés avec la solution qui préserve le mieux le sujet et son intention, sans accumuler de nouveaux effets.

original.title: City Poster Digital Art Prompt
original.prompt:
A city rendering digital art poster for [{argument name="city name" default="city name"}].

The core subject of the image is a miniature island floating above white clouds, shaped like the selected city and occupying most of the frame. The shape of the island is similar to the city's map outline, seamlessly integrating the city's unique iconic landmarks, natural landscapes, and cultural elements. Include birds unique to the city, cinematic lighting, vibrant colors, aerial perspective, and sun reflection effects. Buildings should not be too numerous or dense.

The island showcases a seamless blend of history and modernity. One part features the city's most representative ancient historical buildings; the other part smoothly transitions into the city's landmark buildings and skyline view.

The island floats above a vast sea of clouds. The sea of clouds is rendered using the traditional art style of the city's cultural sphere.

3D text of the city's Pinyin or English name floats above the miniature island. This group of text acts like a miniature ecological device where ecology and culture coexist.

Around the frame and the main subject, layer a minimalist, elegant information layout layer with the texture of a museum display panel. Primarily retrieve relevant city information, using classic serif fonts for main information and extremely fine minimalist sans-serif fonts for auxiliary data. In the corners of the frame, arrange the information like a classical atlas or a high-end magazine title page. Use serif fonts to label the city's geographical coordinates, alias, or founding year, and the current weather, serving as decorative background information. The overall layout uses extensive negative space, is restrained, clean, and balanced, as if appreciating a precious work of art.

Style requirements: Octane Render, C4D, Isometric City, Micro World, Living Ecosystem, 8k Resolution. DreamWorks style, 3D modeling, delicate, soft light projection.

original.title: Winter Solstice City Food Art Poster Prompt
original.prompt:
A city rendering digital art poster for 【{argument name="city name" default="city name"}】, with the Winter Solstice solar term as the overall background atmosphere.
The core subject of the image is a floating miniature island, shaped like the selected city and occupying most of the frame. The outline of the island is similar to the city's map shape, seamlessly integrating the city's unique iconic landmarks, natural landscapes, and cultural elements.
The miniature island is entirely carried or enveloped by the most representative traditional food imagery of the city during the Winter Solstice. Only one specific type of food should be chosen, determined by the city and regional culture (e.g., dumplings, tangyuan). Do not show a specific plate, but translate the form, texture, and structure of this oversized food into the island's shell, terrain, or supporting structure, making the city appear to grow upon this large Winter Solstice food item.
The island is placed within a realistic yet restrained Winter Solstice cooking scene based on the traditional food mentioned above, such as a stove, boiling pot/steamer, or soup pot in a daily kitchen environment. However, background elements are presented with blurring and soft focus, only hinting at the atmosphere of life and cooking. Steam and heat slowly rise, combining with warm winter lighting to create a quiet, warm, and human-touch solar term atmosphere.
Cinematic lighting, vibrant but restrained colors, aerial perspective, and winter light reflection effects. The number of buildings should not be too many or too dense.
The interior of the island showcases a seamless blend of history and modernity: one part presents the city's most representative ancient historical buildings; the other part naturally transitions into the city's landmark buildings and skyline view, all reflecting the current weather conditions (must confirm real weather conditions).
3D text of the city's Chinese name, formed by the steam from the pot, floats above the miniature island. The text acts like a miniature ecological device coexisting with the Winter Solstice, food, and city culture.
Around the frame and the main subject, add an information layout layer with a Winter Solstice festive atmosphere and local life feel, with the overall style conforming to traditional Chinese culture.
Automatically retrieve basic city information and Winter Solstice solar term information related to 【city name】, providing a simple introduction. Text layout uses an asymmetrical, naturally distributed arrangement, scattered around the edges and negative space of the frame, avoiding strict grids and centered composition.
In the corners or edges of the frame, present the city's geographical coordinates, alias, or founding year, and the weather and solar term reminder for the Winter Solstice day, in the style of a local festival poster or old calendar, as decorative information elements. The overall layout maintains significant negative space, but the atmosphere leans towards warmth, domesticity, and festivity.
The copywriting should be concise and refined.
Style requirements:
Octane Render, C4D, Isometric City, Micro World, Living Ecosystem, 8k Resolution, DreamWorks style, 3D modeling, delicate, soft light projection

original.title: Persona 5-inspired pop-art anime poster for a custom chuunibyou character
original.prompt:
Generate a visually explosive and trendy pop-art anime illustration. The main character of the image is "{argument name="character" default="an over-the-top chuunibyou knight"}", and the overall style should reference Persona 5 and street graffiti visuals, turning the character into an extremely flamboyant, extremely flat, ultra-cool anime figure.

Use sharp cel-shading for the character, with hard, clean lines and crisp contours. The pose must be exaggerated and full of motion. You can use wide-angle or fisheye perspectives so that hands, weapons, or props appear extremely close to the camera, like a freeze-frame at the moment a special attack is unleashed. The expression should be highly dramatic, with confident, manic, or cold-blooded "overacting" intensity, rather than a calm everyday look.

Reject realistic volume and shading; instead, rely on large areas of pure black heavy shadows and highly saturated flat color blocks to create an extreme, high-contrast flat look. The main colors can be bright red, lemon yellow, electric blue, neon purple, etc., contrasted against large black shadow silhouettes. Add screentones, halftone dots, speed lines, and radiating lines in the shadows and background so the image feels like printed manga layered with street graffiti.

The background does not need realistic perspective space; it should be a flat visual collage stage filled with huge sans-serif English letters, torn paper effects, ink splatters, bold arrow graphics, speech bubbles, and onomatopoeia, such as exaggerated "BOOM", "SLASH", or "WAKE UP" graffiti sound effects. You can integrate UI elements into the scene—health bars, skill names, buttons, numbers, tooltips—floating around the main character, as if the game interface and the illustration have merged, breaking the fourth wall.

Keep lighting high-contrast but not physically realistic; think in terms of graphic design areas of black/white/color rather than natural light logic. Edges between color areas on the character and background should be very sharp, without soft gradients; all colors should be clearly separated. You can add rough spray paint, smears, or hand-drawn graffiti textures in select areas to enhance the street and handmade feel.

The overall mood must be extremely dynamic, extremely chuunibyou, and extremely cool, as if the image is about to explode out of the screen, not quietly hang in a gallery. Avoid realistic oil painting styles, low-saturation vintage looks, or gentle, soft illustration styles. Do not use natural landscapes or everyday life backgrounds, and avoid soft, pastel color schemes. The image should be a vertical 2:3 high-resolution illustration, suitable as a tension-filled, maximalist pop-art manga poster.

original.title: Cinematic Vigilante Graphic Poster
original.prompt:
A cinematic, vertical graphic poster of a masked vigilante in a tactical carbon-fiber suit. The character is positioned in the foreground with a gritty, matte black texture. The background features massive, bold stencil-style typography in a deep crimson red with heavy metallic scratching and weathered textures. The lighting is low-key and dramatic, with subtle rim lighting on the suit to define its armor plates. High-contrast noir aesthetic, moody atmosphere, sharp details, 8k resolution, Extreme macro close-up of a monstrous green-skinned face, focused on the nose, furrowed brow, and intense glowing green eyes. The skin is hyper-detailed with deep wrinkles, sweat, and a rough, leathery texture. Overlaid vertically across the center is the word "HULK" in large, bold, weathered white sans-serif typography with a metallic, scratched finish. The color palette is dominated by deep emerald greens and shadows, featuring explosive green energy particles and debris flying across the frame. Cinematic lighting, gritty atmosphere, 8k resolution, hyper-realistic, aggressive and powerful mood.

original.title: Gallery-Quality Tribute Poster with Textured Photo Mosaic Silhouette
original.prompt:
Create a refined, gallery-quality tribute poster built around a central portrait silhouette filled with a textured photo mosaic. The design should feel tactile, layered, and premium not like flat digital collage work. 

Central Structure : The Vessel The central focus must be a large-scale, high-contrast black and white portrait silhouette of {argument name="person's name" default="[Persons name]"}.
This silhouette acts as the container for the internal visual narrative. It must be centered perfectly on the canvas. The Grid Fill and Mixed Media Textures The interior of the silhouette should be populated by a dense photo mosaic grid made from action shots throughout the person’s career. Critical Texture Direction Do not paste flat photos. Each grid cell should have artistic treatment to create a tactile, collage-like aesthetic. Incorporate a mix of the following textures selectively across different cells: Halftone dots (comic-book style raster patterns) 
Fabric or embroidery textures suggesting jersey material or stitched patches Film grain or heavy noise on high-contrast action shots The result should feel handcrafted and layered rather than digitally assembled. 

Color Strategy Base palette: monochrome black and white. Introduce selective color overlays only on specific grid cells. The accent colors should relate to the relevant team, brand, or national flag. Use color sparingly to create visual rhythm and emphasis. 

Typography and Branding – Strict Micro-Scaling Top Left (The name) Write “{argument name="person's name" default="[person name]"}” using the font Inter Semibold. Kerning: tight negative kerning , Size: small and discreet. The name must occupy a maximum of 20% of the total canvas width. Do not make it large or dominant. 
Top Right (The symbol) Place the primary logo (Team, Brand, or Flag). Size: very small. It must occupy a maximum of 10% of the total canvas width. 

Composition and Background Background Use off-white or light grey. Include a visible high-quality paper or subtle concrete texture. Avoid flat digital white. 
Alignment Center the silhouette precisely. Maintain generous negative space around the figure to preserve elegance and balance.

Valeurs : Séparer les grandes masses claires et sombres avant les détails. Conserver une silhouette forte et quelques transitions intermédiaires ; garder les noirs utiles sans perdre le contour du sujet sur le fond.

Typographie : Composer les mots exacts demandés, avec accents, ponctuation et espacement régulier. Éviter les lettres fusionnées ou tronquées. Garder des blocs lisibles et limiter le nombre de familles typographiques au nécessaire.

Support : Adapter les traces d’impression au style choisi : grain, encrage ou léger décalage restent subtils et localisés. La texture du papier ne doit pas dégrader la lisibilité des lettres ni masquer le sujet.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

Proportions : Vérifier les rapports de taille entre sujet, accessoires et environnement. Les changements de profondeur expliquent les différences de taille ; éviter des éléments secondaires anormalement grands ou des détails sans épaisseur.

original.title: Anna Karenina Diorama Poster in DreamWorks Style
original.prompt:
A high-quality 3D isometric miniature diorama poster of "Anna Karenina," rendered in a detailed DreamWorks Animation style. The central model captures the famous train station meeting during a fierce blizzard. A massive 19th-century steam locomotive with glowing headlights and billowing smoke is stopped at a snow-covered platform. Anna Karenina, in rich fur clothing, steps off the train, locking eyes with Vronsky, who approaches through the swirling snow. Other bundled figures struggle against the wind. The lighting is dramatic, contrasting warm gas lamps and train lights against the cold blue storm. The miniature is suspended in an ethereal void filled with flowing, elegant Chinese ink wash patterns (shui-mo) in indigo, grey, and faint gold, mixed with glowing light fog, creating depth and a "breathing" atmosphere. At the bottom center, like a museum plaque, the title "Anna Karenina" is written in a ornate, custom design font resembling frosted ironwork. Below it, in an elegant serif font, is the phrase "At that snowy station, fate arrived with the whistle of a train.". The overall composition is balanced, exquisite, and emotionally resonant. --ar 2:3 --v 6.0

original.title: High-End Sports Graphic Poster Template
original.prompt:
[PERSON NAME].
Act as a high-end sports graphic designer creating a conceptual tribute poster. The style is a complex "dual exposure photo-grid composite" with mixed-media textures.
CENTRAL STRUCTURE (THE VESSEL):
The central focus is a large-scale, high-contrast black and white portrait silhouette of {argument name="person name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}. This main portrait acts as the container.
THE GRID FILL & TEXTURES (MIXED MEDIA):
The interior of the silhouette is populated by a dense "photo mosaic grid" of action shots from the person's career.
CRITICAL TEXTURE INSTRUCTION: Do not just paste flat photos. Apply artistic textures to various grid cells to create a tactile, collage feel. Use effects like:
Halftone Dots: Comic-book style raster patterns on some cells.
Fabric/Embroidery: Subtle thread or canvas textures suggesting a jersey or patch.
Film Grain: Heavy noise on specific high-contrast action shots.
COLOR STRATEGY:
The base is Monochrome B&W. Use selective color overlays (relevant to the team/flag) ONLY on specific grid cells to create a rhythm.
TYPOGRAPHY & BRANDING (STRICT MICRO-SCALING):
Top Left (The Name): Write "{argument name="person name 2" default="[PERSON NAME]"}" strictly using the font Inter Semibold.
Kerning: Tight negative kerning (-4%).
Size: SMALL and discreet. It must occupy MAXIMUM 20% of the canvas width. Do NOT make it large or loud.
Top Right (The Symbol): Place the primary logo (Team/Brand/Flag).
Size: VERY SMALL. It must occupy MAXIMUM 10% of the canvas width.
COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND:
Background: Off-white or light grey with a visible high-quality paper or concrete texture. It should not be flat digital white.
Alignment: Center the figure perfectly. Maintain wide negative space around the object.

original.title: Regional Cultural Atlas Poster
original.prompt:
2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 under rated breakfasts of Southern hemisphere: INPUT = [{argument name="category" default="TOPIC_CATEGORY"} / {argument name="region" default="REGION_SET"} / {argument name="criteria" default="SELECTION_CRITERIA"} / {argument name="mood" default="MOOD"}]
MODE = no_hardcoding / inference_only

Run REGIONAL_CULTURAL_ATLAS_EXTRACTION:

CATEGORY_DNA := infer what type of thing is being compared, how it is used, why it matters, and what makes it visually recognizable

REGION_DNA[each] := infer local environment, visual culture, palette, typography attitude, textures, symbols, landscapes, tools, rituals, and social context

ITEM_SELECTION[each] := infer one overlooked or representative item that fits TOPIC_CATEGORY + REGION + SELECTION_CRITERIA

HERO_VISUAL[each] := infer the best visual treatment:
plated food, product close-up, ritual scene, tool layout, garment portrait, object still life, landscape-backed artifact, map-backed diagram, or symbolic vignette

COPY_SYSTEM[each] := generate:

original.title: Torn Poster of Contrasting Kyoto Eras
original.prompt:
Create a [2:3] poster where the center is torn diagonally, revealing two contrasting eras of Kyoto. On the top-left torn layer, show Kyoto in the 1920s with sepia-toned streets, vintage rickshaws, and traditional machiya townhouses. On the bottom-right exposed layer, show a futuristic Kyoto in the year 2080, with hovering transit pods, holographic cherry blossom advertisements, and sleek vertical gardens integrated into cyber-shinto towers.  The torn paper edges are crisp and textured, curling slightly to cast shadows. The word “KYOTO” spans across both eras in bold typography, transitioning from retro woodblock-style lettering on the left to sleek sci-fi neon kanji on the right. Soft studio light, high-resolution print-ready render, clean off-white border.

original.title: Architectural Typography Micro-World Render Prompt (New York)
original.prompt:
Do this for {argument name="city" default="New York"}: System Instruction:
Generate a hyper-realistic 3D architectural typography render. The letters must act as massive, hollow containers housing a "Micro-World" that semantically matches the Input Word.
1. Semantic Inference (The Blueprint):
Analyze the Input Word to determine the Biome, Material, and Lighting:
If Organic (e.g., JUNGLE, LIFE): Material = Glass & Wood. Interior = Vines, Waterfalls, Trees. Light = Sunlight/Green.
If Urban (e.g., CITY, NYC): Material = Steel & Concrete. Interior = Skyscrapers, Traffic, Streetlights. Light = Amber/Blue.
If Industrial (e.g., FACTORY, RUST): Material = Rusted Iron & Mesh. Interior = Pipes, Steam, Gears. Light = Orange Furnace glow.
If Abstract (e.g., LOVE, HOPE): Material = Gold or White Marble. Interior = Floating petals, soft clouds, candles. Light = Soft Pink/Gold.
2. The Immutable Container (The Mega-Letters):
Geometry: Massive, blocky sans-serif typography.
The Shell: The letterforms are Hollow Containers with open faces or glass walls. They act like terrariums or shadow boxes.
The Base: The letters rest on a surface relevant to the theme (e.g., A map for Cities; Moss for Nature; Blueprint for Industry).
3. The Internal Ecosystem (The Diorama):
CRITICAL: The "World" lives inside the negative space of the letters.
The Density: Fill the interior volume with thousands of tiny details (Micro-Scale).
Example: If "TOKYO," tiny neon signs, vending machines, and pedestrians fill the inside of the "T".
The Verticality: Use the height of the letters. Elevators, vines, or ladders should climb up the vertical strokes.
4. Visual Syntax:
Scale: Tilt-Shift Focus. Blur the background to make the letters look like tangible miniature models.
Detail: High-frequency textures. We need to see individual leaves, bricks, or rivets.
5. Lighting:
Internal Glow: The letters are lit from within by the bioluminescence or streetlights of the micro-world.
External Sun: A soft studio key light highlights the rim of the letter casing.
Output: 3D Render, Octane/Redshift, "Micro-World" Aesthetic, 8k Resolution.

Composition éditoriale : Organiser l’image en trois niveaux : titre, visuel principal, informations secondaires si elles sont fournies. Préserver de vraies marges et des espaces calmes ; les éléments décoratifs ne doivent pas rivaliser avec le message.

Proportions : Vérifier les rapports de taille entre sujet, accessoires et environnement. Les changements de profondeur expliquent les différences de taille ; éviter des éléments secondaires anormalement grands ou des détails sans épaisseur.

If Industrial (e.g., FACTORY, RUST): Material = Rusted Iron & Mesh. Interior = Pipes, Steam, Gears. Light = Orange Furnace glow.
If Abstract (e.g., LOVE, HOPE): Material = Gold or White Marble. Interior = Floating petals, soft clouds, candles. Light = Soft Pink/Gold.

Scale: Tilt-Shift Focus. Blur the background to make the letters look like tangible miniature models.
Detail: High-frequency textures. We need to see individual leaves, bricks, or rivets.

Internal Glow: The letters are lit from within by the bioluminescence or streetlights of the micro-world.
External Sun: A soft studio key light highlights the rim of the letter casing.

original.title: 3D Diorama Poster for Film/Novel Scenes
original.prompt:
Please design a high-quality 3D poster for the film/novel "{argument name="name" default="Name to be added"}", requiring prior retrieval of information about the film/novel and famous scene clips.

First, use your knowledge base to retrieve the content of this film/novel and find the most representative famous scene or core location. In the center of the image, construct this scene as an exquisite isometric 3D miniature model. The style should adopt the delicate, soft rendering style of Dreamworks animation. You need to restore the architectural details, character dynamics, and environmental atmosphere of the time; whether it's a storm or a tranquil afternoon, it should naturally blend into the model's lighting and shadows.

Regarding the background, do not use a simple pure white base. Please create a void environment around the model with faint ink wash blending and flowing light mist, with elegant color tones, making the image appear breathable and deep, highlighting the preciousness of the central model.

Finally, for the layout at the bottom, generate Chinese text. Center the name of the novel, with a font design that matches the style of the original work. Below the title, automatically retrieve and lay out a classic description or line from the original work related to that scene, using an elegant serif font. The overall layout should be exquisitely balanced, like a high-end museum collection plaque.

The text is strictly full-bleed, stretching perfectly and touching the absolute top and absolute bottom edges of the frame with zero vertical padding, gaps, or margins. This typography acts as a stencil mask: the letters reveal the underlying character, while the space to the far left of the letters is a solid, clean white.

Subject Details & Positioning: An upper-body shot of [{argument name="character description" default="CHARACTER DESCRIPTION"}]. The model is positioned so that only her left-most side is visible through the letters, while the rest of her body is fully visible and contained on the right side against a solid [{argument name="color" default="COLOR"}] background, ensuring no part of the subject is cropped by the right edge of the frame. Pose: [POSE DESCRIPTION], ensuring the silhouette remains within the center of the right two-thirds area.

Secondary Text: In the top right corner, add the text: "[TEXT]". Use a small, sophisticated, white "Helvetica Condensed" style font with wide letter spacing (kerning) for a premium, minimalist look. Color Palette: A strict monochromatic [COLOR] theme, sharply contrasted by the crisp white negative space on the left. 8k resolution, photorealistic textures, sharp studio lighting, high contrast, clean graphic design aesthetic.

original.title: Watercolor Woodland Children Illustrations
original.prompt:
A whimsical collection of {argument name="art style" default="watercolor illustrations"} featuring young, freckled children with expressive eyes in a {argument name="setting" default="lush woodland setting"}. The style uses vibrant, bleeding watercolor washes, soft ink outlines, and a dreamy atmosphere. Key scenes include a boy in a colorful hoodie, a boy sitting cross-legged reading a book, a girl with teal hair writing with a quill on a tree stump, and a girl with golden braids gathering {argument name="props" default="wildflowers and berries"} into a basket.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Watercolor Woodland Children Illustrations
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Geste : Faire sentir un dessin réalisé par étapes : lignes de construction discrètes, reprises de contour et variations de pression. Garder les irrégularités naturelles sans rendre le sujet confus ni répéter mécaniquement la même marque.

Veines du bois : Orienter le veinage selon la forme et le sens de fabrication, avec des variations naturelles entre fibres claires et foncées. Les changements de plan restent lisibles ; éviter le même motif de veines répété à l’identique.

Pigments et eau : Alterner lavis transparents, bords diffus et quelques contours plus nets. Montrer de légères accumulations de pigment et réserver le blanc du papier pour les lumières ; éviter un flou uniforme qui efface le dessin.

original.title: Vintage Graphite Pencil Portrait
original.prompt:
Create a 4:5 aspect ratio, highly detailed black-and-white graphite pencil portrait of a beautiful female subject standing near the ocean, shown from the chest up in a classic vintage style. She has soft expressive eyes gazing slightly off-camera, naturally arched eyebrows, defined lips slightly parted, and a calm, emotional expression that feels thoughtful, wistful, and quietly romantic. Her {argument name="hair style" default="long wavy hair is loose and windswept, with strands flowing across her forehead and outward in the sea breeze"}. She wears small delicate drop earrings and a {argument name="outfit" default="vintage period outfit: a softly draped embroidered outer garment with decorative floral trim along the edges, layered over a fitted dress with a square neckline, lace edging"}, subtle stitched floral detailing on the bodice, and gentle fabric folds. The background shows a calm ocean horizon with gentle waves and a simple wooden railing behind her, softly sketched with horizontal pencil strokes. Use realistic graphite shading, fine cross-hatching, visible pencil texture, soft paper grain, detailed hair strokes, subtle facial shadows, natural skin shading, and hand-drawn sketch realism. Keep the composition centered, chest-up framing, timeless romantic mood, elegant seaside atmosphere, highly detailed pencil artwork, monochrome, no color, no digital painting look. Features a subtle, elegant handwritten artist signature watermark text "Kinza" in the bottom corner.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Vintage Graphite Pencil Portrait
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Geste : Faire sentir un dessin réalisé par étapes : lignes de construction discrètes, reprises de contour et variations de pression. Garder les irrégularités naturelles sans rendre le sujet confus ni répéter mécaniquement la même marque.

Dessin : Varier pression et direction des traits selon les volumes. Les contours importants restent clairs ; éviter les zones noircies sans intention. Si c’est une page de coloriage, garder des formes fermées et des intérieurs dégagés.

turn this photo into a chaotic hand-drawn crayon sketch with a {argument name="signature style" default="VERY consistent signature art style"}, {argument name="background" default="white paper background"}, thick dark-brown scratchy outlines drawn with cheap colored pencils, large circular bug-like eyes with tiny pupils and heavy uneven outlines, elongated distorted face shape caused by exaggerated fisheye perspective, tiny compressed mouth, detailed wrinkled under-eyes and chaotic facial shading made from layered crayon strokes, skin colored using rough overlapping pink, peach and red scribbles instead of smooth coloring, messy visible wax crayon texture everywhere, rough uneven coloring outside the lines, aggressive crosshatching and random sketch marks, hands drawn slightly too large with awkward finger anatomy, background filled with childish doodles,random flowers, handwritten words, arrows and chaotic notebook-style decorations, intentionally overcrowded composition, every object outlined with the same dark scratchy pencil style, hyperactive kindergarten sketchbook energy, weirdly expressive and funny, visually consistent recognizable drawing style

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Chaotic Crayon Sketch Style

Cadrage : Placer le sujet et les éventuelles annotations avec de l’air autour. Les petites touches attirent le regard vers les éléments importants ; elles ne doivent pas remplir uniformément chaque coin de la page.

original.title: Whimsical Japanese Watercolor Portrait
original.prompt:
A whimsical high-fashion watercolor portrait collection inspired by the elegance of {argument name="muse" default="Yui Aragaki"}, portrayed as a beautiful, attractive, intelligent, and graceful Japanese woman in a {argument name="setting" default="lush enchanted woodland setting"}.

Style: vibrant watercolor illustration with flowing bleeding paint washes, delicate soft ink outlines, dreamy cinematic atmosphere, handcrafted watercolor textures, elegant editorial fashion aesthetic, subtle paper grain, and poetic fantasy realism. The artwork blends sophisticated Japanese beauty photography with magical storybook charm.

Key scenes include:
• {argument name="muse" default="Yui Aragaki"} standing gracefully among towering forest trees wearing a luxurious pastel trench coat and flowing silk dress, soft sunlight filtering through leaves, expressive eyes and calm confident expression.
• {argument name="muse" default="Yui Aragaki"} sitting cross-legged on a moss-covered stone while reading a vintage book, surrounded by floating flower petals and glowing watercolor splashes.
• {argument name="muse" default="Yui Aragaki"} thoughtfully writing with a feather quill at a rustic wooden table in the woodland, emerald and teal watercolor accents softly blending into the dreamy background.
• {argument name="muse" default="Yui Aragaki"} gathering wildflowers and berries into a woven basket while wearing a soft cream cardigan and elegant flowing skirt, cinematic golden-hour lighting illuminating her face.

Art direction:
dreamy watercolor fantasy, ultra-detailed facial features, elegant Japanese fashion styling, natural beauty, subtle freckles, soft blush tones, fluid watercolor textures, expressive eyes, cinematic composition, handcrafted illustration feel, magical forest ambience, luxury editorial poster aesthetic, highly artistic and visually poetic.

Composition:
vertical 3:4 poster layout, balanced negative space, layered woodland foliage depth, flowing watercolor edges, atmospheric soft-focus background blur, harmonious color palette of emerald green, warm gold, ivory, pastel pink, and soft teal.

Additional details:
place the name “{argument name="muse" default="YUI ARAGAKI"}” elegantly at the bottom of the poster in refined minimalist typography integrated naturally into the composition.

Quality:
ultra-high resolution, masterpiece quality, clean watercolor detailing, gallery-worthy illustration, refined artistic sophistication, soft cinematic lighting, no photorealism, no harsh shadows, no watermark.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Whimsical Japanese Watercolor Portrait
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Geste : Faire sentir un dessin réalisé par étapes : lignes de construction discrètes, reprises de contour et variations de pression. Garder les irrégularités naturelles sans rendre le sujet confus ni répéter mécaniquement la même marque.

Pigments et eau : Alterner lavis transparents, bords diffus et quelques contours plus nets. Montrer de légères accumulations de pigment et réserver le blanc du papier pour les lumières ; éviter un flou uniforme qui efface le dessin.

Papier et technique : Faire interagir le médium demandé avec le support : réserve du papier, superposition des traces et densités variables. Préserver une différence entre le grain du papier et les détails représentés.

Cadrage : Placer le sujet et les éventuelles annotations avec de l’air autour. Les petites touches attirent le regard vers les éléments importants ; elles ne doivent pas remplir uniformément chaque coin de la page.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

original.title: Traditional Masterpiece Sketch Technique
original.prompt:
Masterpiece, best quality, 8k, ultra sharp, PURE ART STYLE ONLY, NO SUBJECT, NO POSE, NO CHARACTER:

Traditional hand-drawn portrait sketch technique on {argument name="paper type" default="aged warm off-white / cream beige kraft paper"} with subtle visible paper fiber grain texture across the entire surface. Strict monochrome palette only: pure jet black, full rich range of soft gray tones, and the natural cream paper color used as the brightest highlight value — no pure white, no other colors anywhere.

LINE TECHNIQUE (EXACT MATCH):
- Mix of three mediums in perfect balance: smooth graphite pencil, soft smudged charcoal, and fluid black ink
- Hair rendered with extremely dynamic, long, flowing, fast directional brush and pencil strokes, many loose stray wispy lines extending freely outside the main form, highly varied line weight from razor-thin delicate strands to bold thick dark masses, intentionally imperfect and spontaneous
- Facial features drawn with refined, soft, subtle contour lines that disappear and reappear naturally, never a harsh continuous outline, gentle pressure variation creating lifelike sensitivity
- Clothing and lower areas use bold, rough, angular, broken brush strokes with visible dry-brush texture, many areas intentionally left incomplete and dissolving into the paper
- Visible sketch construction lines subtly showing through in lighter areas as part of the aesthetic

SHADING & BRUSH WASH TECHNIQUE (EXACT MATCH):
- Large shadow areas (hair mass, neck, clothing) built from broad, translucent, layered black ink wash / watered-down charcoal washes with soft bleeding edges
- Overlaid on washes: expressive directional hatching and cross-hatching strokes following 3D form curvature
- Facial skin rendered with ultra-smooth blended charcoal gradients, extremely subtle hatching, almost invisible soft transitions for realistic volume, no harsh marks on the face
- Contrast is strong but soft: deep rich near-black areas balanced by delicate mid-gray gradients, with the cream paper itself acting as the natural highlight
- Many hard-edged bold brush strokes placed intentionally next to soft smudged areas for dynamic tension

COMPLETION GRADIENT:
- Central facial area = highly refined, smooth, realistic, fully rendered with precise detail
- Radiating outward and downward = gradually becomes looser, faster, rougher, more abstract, more incomplete, with strokes cutting off abruptly and dissolving naturally into the bare paper background, no hard border to the artwork
- Authentic work-in-progress / sketchbook page aesthetic"

OVERALL AESTHETIC:
Loose, expressive, emotional, confident, painterly sketch feel, clearly hand-drawn by a master artist, fashion illustration meets fine art academic sketch, elegant movement, dynamic energy, no digital smoothness, no vector perfection, every stroke carries intention --ar 9:16 --style raw --stylize 300 --v 6.0, {argument name="clothing accent" default="the clothes are given a soft dark green touch"}

Travail du trait : Décrire ombres et volumes par la densité des traits, hachures ou points plutôt que par un flou photographique. Conserver des noirs francs, des blancs utiles et une variation de densité qui accompagne les formes.

Papier et technique : Faire interagir le médium demandé avec le support : réserve du papier, superposition des traces et densités variables. Préserver une différence entre le grain du papier et les détails représentés.

Cadrage : Placer le sujet et les éventuelles annotations avec de l’air autour. Les petites touches attirent le regard vers les éléments importants ; elles ne doivent pas remplir uniformément chaque coin de la page.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

Proportions : Vérifier les rapports de taille entre sujet, accessoires et environnement. Les changements de profondeur expliquent les différences de taille ; éviter des éléments secondaires anormalement grands ou des détails sans épaisseur.

Cohérence chromatique : Utiliser la palette indiquée dans le brief avec des variations de valeur et de saturation. Éviter d’introduire une couleur dominante supplémentaire ; les accents servent à distinguer le sujet ou une information précise.

Qualité des contours : Adapter la netteté au médium : une limite découpée, un bord de peinture et un contour photographique ne se traitent pas de la même façon. Éviter la suraccentuation, les franges lumineuses et les doubles contours.

Équilibre : Répartir les masses visuelles de manière intentionnelle et laisser des espaces de respiration. Ne pas déplacer le sujet principal pour combler un vide utile ; contrôler l’image en réduction pour vérifier qu’elle reste compréhensible.

Priorités : Les quantités, couleurs, mots exacts, proportions et éléments imposés dans la demande initiale priment sur les conseils de finition. Résoudre les ambiguïtés avec la solution qui préserve le mieux le sujet et son intention, sans accumuler de nouveaux effets.

original.title: Colored Pencil Meadow Landscape
original.prompt:
A vibrant colored-pencil illustration in portrait orientation. A young couple walks hand in hand away from the viewer along a narrow winding path through a vast field of vivid blue cornflowers (Centaurea cyanus) in the foreground, among tall golden-yellow grass, with stems and buds interspersed. The woman wears a flowing white dress, the man a white shirt with rolled-up sleeves and dark trousers, their heads tilted gently toward each other. Gentle rolling hills stretch toward the horizon. A soft summer breeze bends the grass and flowers as the evening light falls across the scene. In the distance, sunlight peeks over warm amber fields. The sky fills the upper third and is colored from deep dusky blue at the top down to warm shades of orange, gold, and pale yellow near the low sun, with soft wispy backlit clouds. The perspective is wide and slightly elevated, showcasing the detailed cornflowers, the couple, and the expansive sunlit meadow. The style is reminiscent of colored pencil art, with visible textures creating a soft, serene mood. The overall atmosphere is peaceful, romantic, and nostalgic, with warm golden tones contrasting against the cool electric blue of the flowers. original.title: Hand-drawn mind map for explaining Chinese idioms
original.prompt:
You are a third-grade Chinese language teacher explaining the following idioms to children. Please analyze step by step: 1) Based on the meaning of each idiom, design suitable scene illustrations. 2) Break down the characters in each idiom and use extended keywords so that kids can immediately remember the key explanation. 3) Arrange the order and layout according to the idioms’ relationships or logic. 4) Draw a fun hand-drawn illustration.
Idioms: “朝三暮四 (changeable), 利令智昏 (blinded by profit), 洛陽紙貴 (hugely popular writing), 張冠李戴 (misattribute), 融會貫通 (master and integrate knowledge), 漠不關心 (indifferent), 心平氣和 (calm and even-tempered), 一毛不拔 (stingy), 欲蓋彌彰 (covering up only reveals more), 盲人摸象 (see only part of the whole), 苦口婆心 (earnest and well-meant advice), 斬釘截鐵 (firm and decisive), 細嚼慢嚥 (chew slowly and carefully), 朝令夕改 (frequent policy changes), 餘波盪漾 (lingering impact), 史無前例 (unprecedented), 身敗名裂 (disgraced and ruined), 兵不厭詐 (all is fair in war), 捲土重來 (make a comeback), 標新立異 (strive for originality).

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Hand-drawn mind map for explaining Chinese idioms
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Geste : Faire sentir un dessin réalisé par étapes : lignes de construction discrètes, reprises de contour et variations de pression. Garder les irrégularités naturelles sans rendre le sujet confus ni répéter mécaniquement la même marque.

Cartographie : Distinguer zones, parcours et repères par un code visuel simple. Les noms et symboles restent lisibles sans se chevaucher. Si la carte est fictive, conserver une géographie intérieure cohérente ; si elle vient d’une référence, respecter ses positions relatives.

Papier et technique : Faire interagir le médium demandé avec le support : réserve du papier, superposition des traces et densités variables. Préserver une différence entre le grain du papier et les détails représentés.

Cadrage : Placer le sujet et les éventuelles annotations avec de l’air autour. Les petites touches attirent le regard vers les éléments importants ; elles ne doivent pas remplir uniformément chaque coin de la page.

original.title: Child's Crayon Drawing Style Generator
original.prompt:
Draw {argument name="visual subject" default="[VISUAL]"} as if created by a cheerful 6-year-old on white notebook paper. Use chunky wax-crayon strokes, wobbly outlines, and simple flat shapes. Colors should be bright, bold, and slightly outside the lines, with visible pressure marks and small smudges. Perspective is innocent: objects can float, and size is based on importance, not realism. Faces are dots with curved smiles; hands are mitten blobs; animals are round and friendly. Add playful extras like a sun in a corner, puffy clouds, stars, and hearts. Include uneven scribble shading, a few tiny doodles in the margins, and one or two hand-written labels in childlike spelling.

The overall aesthetic combines vintage retro-futurism, cosmic surrealism, and a dreamy watercolor collage style.

original.title: Double Exposure Pencil Sketch
original.prompt:
A pencil sketch utilizing a {argument name=\"effect\" default=\"double exposure effect\"} to merge two facial profiles of the same {argument name=\"subject\" default=\"young man\"} with a serene landscape. The left profile looks upward and into the distance with a hopeful or contemplative expression, while the right profile is cast downward in a look of introspection or melancholy. Within the silhouette of their necks and shoulders, a {argument name=\"landscape\" default=\"detailed nature scene\"} unfolds, featuring a lone traveler with a backpack walking along a path next to a calm lake, surrounded by pine trees, distant mountains, and a flock of birds flying across a textured sky.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Double Exposure Pencil Sketch
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Geste : Faire sentir un dessin réalisé par étapes : lignes de construction discrètes, reprises de contour et variations de pression. Garder les irrégularités naturelles sans rendre le sujet confus ni répéter mécaniquement la même marque.

Travail du trait : Décrire ombres et volumes par la densité des traits, hachures ou points plutôt que par un flou photographique. Conserver des noirs francs, des blancs utiles et une variation de densité qui accompagne les formes.

Dessin : Varier pression et direction des traits selon les volumes. Les contours importants restent clairs ; éviter les zones noircies sans intention. Si c’est une page de coloriage, garder des formes fermées et des intérieurs dégagés.

2x2 grid, do this for 4 titles in a famous comic universe: <spatial_map>
    [ VERTICAL SCENIC BACKDROP (BOOK COVER) ]
    |      (Floating Label: [{argument name="issue title" default="ISSUE_TITLE"} | {argument name="year" default="YEAR"}])
    |                                            |
    |      [3D TOY: {argument name="hero" default="HERO"}] vs [3D TOY: {argument name="villain" default="VILLAIN"}]   |
    |          \__ [3D PLASTIC FX] __/           |
    |                                            |
 ---+--------------------------------------------+---
   /    [OPEN BOOK PAGES WITH COMIC PANELS]     /
  /                                            /
 /      [ FLOATING 3D TEXT: [SFX_WORD]! ]     /
/____________________________________________/
</spatial_map>
Instruction: Render a photorealistic 3D diorama matching this exact structural geometry.

original.title: Anime Film Storyboard Board
original.prompt:
STORY

Panel 1

Warm cloudy evening after light rain.

A small neighborhood park glows under golden sunset light.

Children are laughing and playing together.

In the distance, the long-haired girl sits alone on a swing.

The empty swing beside her slowly moves in the wind.

Camera note:
Wide establishing shot.

⸻

Panel 2

Close-up.

The girl watches the other children from afar while quietly spinning her handmade paper windmill.

A faint sad smile appears.

Camera note:
Slow push-in.

⸻

Panel 3

A sudden gust of wind lifts the paper windmill from her hands.

It flies across the park.

The girl stands and runs after it.

Camera note:
Tracking shot.

⸻

Panel 4

The windmill lands near a group of children playing.

The girl hesitates and freezes.

She is too shy to approach them.

From her perspective the group feels intimidating and distant.

Camera note:
Low-angle emotional POV.

⸻

Panel 5

One of the children notices the windmill.

Instead of simply returning it, the group carefully repairs a torn corner and decorates it with colorful drawings and messages.

The girl watches in surprise.

Camera note:
Medium emotional shot.

⸻

Panel 6

The kindest child walks toward her with a warm smile and gently offers the windmill back.

The group invites her to join them.

Camera note:
Soft close-up.

⸻

Panel 7

The girl’s eyes fill with tears.

For the first time she smiles openly.

She runs toward the group while clutching the repaired windmill.

Camera note:
Dynamic running shot with sunset backlight.

⸻

Panel 8

Final emotional wide shot.

The girl and her new friends laugh together beneath glowing sunset clouds.

The once-empty swing gently moves in the background.

The repaired windmill spins in the warm evening breeze.

Mood:
{argument name="mood" default="Bittersweet, heartwarming, unforgettable"}.

Camera note:
Large cinematic ending frame.

FINAL GOAL

Create a breathtaking premium {argument name="style" default="anime film development board"} that tells a deeply emotional story about {argument name="theme" default="loneliness, kindness, and finding friendship"}.

The artwork should feel like a lost masterpiece from a classic theatrical anime studio, with stunning painted backgrounds, expressive character acting, emotional visual storytelling, and a touching ending that leaves a lasting emotional impact.

Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Geste : Faire sentir un dessin réalisé par étapes : lignes de construction discrètes, reprises de contour et variations de pression. Garder les irrégularités naturelles sans rendre le sujet confus ni répéter mécaniquement la même marque.

Caractère analogique : Adapter le grain, les couleurs et les petites imperfections au procédé demandé. Les défauts restent mesurés et ne doivent pas effacer le sujet ; éviter les poussières, rayures et fuites de lumière ajoutées partout sans logique.

Continuité : Conserver les personnages, accessoires et codes de couleur d’une case à l’autre. Faire varier le cadrage pour servir l’action, tout en gardant un ordre de lecture clair et des gouttières régulières.

Papier et technique : Faire interagir le médium demandé avec le support : réserve du papier, superposition des traces et densités variables. Préserver une différence entre le grain du papier et les détails représentés.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

Create a breathtaking premium {argument name="style" default="anime film development board"} that tells a deeply emotional story about {argument name="theme" default="loneliness, kindness, and finding friendship"}.

The artwork should feel like a lost masterpiece from a classic theatrical anime studio, with stunning painted backgrounds, expressive character acting, emotional visual storytelling, and a touching ending that leaves a lasting emotional impact.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Anime Film Storyboard Board
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Geste : Faire sentir un dessin réalisé par étapes : lignes de construction discrètes, reprises de contour et variations de pression. Garder les irrégularités naturelles sans rendre le sujet confus ni répéter mécaniquement la même marque.

Caractère analogique : Adapter le grain, les couleurs et les petites imperfections au procédé demandé. Les défauts restent mesurés et ne doivent pas effacer le sujet ; éviter les poussières, rayures et fuites de lumière ajoutées partout sans logique.

Continuité : Conserver les personnages, accessoires et codes de couleur d’une case à l’autre. Faire varier le cadrage pour servir l’action, tout en gardant un ordre de lecture clair et des gouttières régulières.

Papier et technique : Faire interagir le médium demandé avec le support : réserve du papier, superposition des traces et densités variables. Préserver une différence entre le grain du papier et les détails représentés.

Cadrage : Placer le sujet et les éventuelles annotations avec de l’air autour. Les petites touches attirent le regard vers les éléments importants ; elles ne doivent pas remplir uniformément chaque coin de la page.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

Proportions : Vérifier les rapports de taille entre sujet, accessoires et environnement. Les changements de profondeur expliquent les différences de taille ; éviter des éléments secondaires anormalement grands ou des détails sans épaisseur.

Cohérence chromatique : Utiliser la palette indiquée dans le brief avec des variations de valeur et de saturation. Éviter d’introduire une couleur dominante supplémentaire ; les accents servent à distinguer le sujet ou une information précise.

Qualité des contours : Adapter la netteté au médium : une limite découpée, un bord de peinture et un contour photographique ne se traitent pas de la même façon. Éviter la suraccentuation, les franges lumineuses et les doubles contours.

original.title: Maple Syrup Commercial Storyboard
original.prompt:
TITLE:
Premium Maple Syrup Product Commercial Storyboard

FORMAT:
• Single-page premium storyboard
• 3:4 Portrait ratio
• Luxury food product advertising
• 8 cinematic product-focused scenes
• Product remains the main hero
• High-end advertising agency presentation

HEADER:
• Elegant serif typography
• Information cards:
  - Duration: 20 Seconds
  - Style: Cinematic Gourmet Food Commercial
  - Product: Pure Maple Syrup
  - Audio: Slow Pour + Soft Food ASMR
• Why This Style Works section
• Warm amber, cream and dark brown aesthetic
• Minimal maple leaf decorative accents

STORYBOARD:
1. Premium maple syrup bottle standing on polished dark wood
2. Bottle cap opening in extreme macro

original.title: Nano Banana Comic Prompt: Elf and Human Love Comedy
original.prompt:
Genre: Modern Fantasy / Romantic Comedy
Format: Vertical 4-panel manga
Style: Bright romantic comedy tone, expressive faces, no grayscale tone expression
Setting: Modern Japanese city streets
Clothing: Modern style (Elf: stylish casual clothes + ears, Man: casual clothes)

Panel 1
Modern city streets.
An elf woman with long ears is standing with her arms crossed, looking cool and exasperated. Positioned on the right side of the screen.
In front of her, a human man is kneeling and offering a bouquet of flowers. Positioned on the left side of the screen.
The man is desperate, and the woman is clearly rejecting him.

Dialogue:
Elf Woman
“Give up already, mortal. I will never accept human love.”

Panel 2
The human man, still holding the bouquet, leans forward desperately. Positioned on the left side of the screen.
The background shows speed lines indicating intensity.
The elf is slightly backing away. Positioned on the right side of the screen.

Dialogue:
Human Man
“In this day and age, interspecies marriage is common! Differences in lifespan or species don't matter when it comes to love!”

Panel 3
The elf woman shows a dark, somber expression, making a gesture as if showing a smartphone. Positioned on the right side of the screen.
The man looks serious, sensing something. Positioned on the left side of the screen.

Dialogue:
Elf
“Hmph, look at this, and tell me if you can still say the same?”

Human Man
(Could it be that Ms. Elf has a sad past!?)

Panel 4
The elf woman shows the smartphone to the human man. Tears are welling up in her eyes. Positioned on the right side of the screen.
The man looks dissatisfied after seeing it. Profile view, positioned on the left side of the screen.

Dialogue:
Elf Woman
“Even you wouldn't want to get involved in a social game that looks like it will end service in a short time, would you?”

Background shows the smartphone screen. The screen displays: “Mortal Love Online ~Lifespan Difference Doesn't Matter☆~ Service has ended.” Styled like an official otome game website.

Human Man
“Ah, I understand the feeling, but I don't want to accept this reason~”

original.title: Dynamic Manga Page Layout Prompt
original.prompt:
A complete Japanese manga page with dynamic varied panel layout. 6 panels with different sizes and shapes - NOT all rectangular. Panel 1 (wide horizontal at top): Sapporo winter cityscape with snow festival preparations, snowy streets. Panel 2 (medium rectangle): Male student's profile closeup, thoughtful expression about upcoming snow festival. Panel 3 (tall narrow vertical on right): Distant small figure of female student running with bread in mouth. Panel 4 (medium trapezoid or angled): Female student getting closer, mid-distance. Panel 5 (small square): Male student's surprised face noticing her. Panel 6 (diagonal tilted panel breaking the grid): Female student very close, dramatic tension building. Ultra-thin consistent linework like technical pen, delicate screentone shading. Black and white manga aesthetic with modern 2020s style. Professional dynamic page composition with varied panel shapes, NOT uniform grid. Space left for speech bubbles.

original.title: Four-Panel Manga: Fantasy Alleyway Wall-Slam
original.prompt:
Format: Japanese 4-panel manga, 4 vertical tiers, grayscale, seinen manga, exaggerated expressions.
Setting: Fantasy world, slum alleyway, dim atmosphere, cobblestones and dirty walls, trash and barrels are placed around.

[Character Settings]
・Rough Man: Outlaw who failed as an adventurer, scarred face, stubble, shabby leather gear, ugly man with a bad attitude.
・Female Hero: Beautiful woman, well-defined features, dignified eyes, clean light armor or hero-style gear, strong-willed expression.

[Panel 1]
Composition: Alleyway, the rough man pushes the female hero against the wall (kabedon).
The man standing on the right is smirking, the female hero cornered against the wall on the left has a frustrated expression.
Dialogue:
Rough Man: "Well, well, look how docile the Hero-sama has become."
Female Hero: "Ugh... you scum..."

[Panel 2]
Composition: Still in the kabedon pose, slightly zoomed in, the man on the right has a confident smile, the female hero glares back.
Dialogue:
Rough Man: "You're quite the eccentric Hero-sama... to fall for an ugly guy like me."
Female Hero: "Stop implying that I'm a pervert!"

[Panel 3]
Composition: Female Hero's serious face, extreme close-up, front view.
Dialogue:
Female Hero: "Your appearance and personality are trash, but your 'stuff' is superb. You should be aware of your own capabilities."
The female hero gives a thumbs-up with a serious face.

[Panel 4]
Composition: Upper body of the man, looking away, face red, confused and flustered. He is fidgeting with his hand on his head.
Background is the alleyway. Onomatopoeia effects like "Doki Doki" (heartbeat).
Dialogue:
Rough Man: "Eh, ah, yes... thank you very much..."

Create one page of a manga featuring these two people. White background with black lines.
Manga theme: {argument name="manga theme" default="An older sister who absolutely cannot remember something important, and her younger sister who cannot guess what it is"}
The manga panels progress from the top right to the bottom left.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Manga page prompt for Nano Banana Pro
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Geste : Faire sentir un dessin réalisé par étapes : lignes de construction discrètes, reprises de contour et variations de pression. Garder les irrégularités naturelles sans rendre le sujet confus ni répéter mécaniquement la même marque.

Continuité : Conserver les personnages, accessoires et codes de couleur d’une case à l’autre. Faire varier le cadrage pour servir l’action, tout en gardant un ordre de lecture clair et des gouttières régulières.

Papier et technique : Faire interagir le médium demandé avec le support : réserve du papier, superposition des traces et densités variables. Préserver une différence entre le grain du papier et les détails représentés.

I want to create a 4-panel manga with a woman as the main character.
The woman is {argument name="nationality_en" default="Japanese"}. She has a bright expression.
{argument name="hairstyle_en" default="Blonde ponytail tied with a red ribbon."}
{argument name="top_outfit_en" default="A white shirt with a rainbow-colored flower patch on her chest."}
{argument name="bottom_outfit_en" default="Jeans and red high heels."}

3: The woman is sitting at a table in the shop saying “{argument name="line3_en" default="I can’t wait to eat"}”.

original.title: The Lighthouse Keeper Storyboard
original.prompt:
{
  "title": "{argument name="story title" default="The Lighthouse Keeper"}",

  "image_description": "A solitary lighthouse stands on a jagged cliff surrounded by a violent ocean storm. Towering waves crash against the rocks below. Lightning tears through dark clouds, briefly illuminating the ancient stone structure. Inside the lighthouse, an elderly keeper slowly climbs a spiral staircase carrying an old lantern. The walls are covered with faded photographs, letters and newspaper clippings spanning decades. Every ship route in the world was abandoned more than fifty years ago. No vessels pass here anymore. Yet every night, without fail, the keeper climbs to the top and turns on the light.",

  "story_element": {
    "twist": "{argument name="plot twist" default="Nobody knows why he still does it."}",
    "secret": "{argument name="the secret" default="Tonight, for the first time in fifty years, a faint light appears on the horizon."}"
  },

  "environment": {
    "weather": "Violent storm",
    "time": "Midnight",
    "atmosphere": "Lonely, mysterious, emotional"
  },

  "symbolism": "Faith and hope without proof.",

  "cinematography": {
    "camera_angle": "Low angle",
    "lens": "85mm anamorphic",
    "lighting": "Lightning flashes and warm lantern glow"
  },

  "mood": [
    "Hope",
    "Mystery",
    "Loneliness",
    "Determination"
  ],

  "quality": {
    "style": "Oscar-winning cinematic drama",
    "resolution": "8K",
    "realism": "Ultra photorealistic"
  }
}

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — The Lighthouse Keeper Storyboard
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Geste : Faire sentir un dessin réalisé par étapes : lignes de construction discrètes, reprises de contour et variations de pression. Garder les irrégularités naturelles sans rendre le sujet confus ni répéter mécaniquement la même marque.

Architecture : Aligner ouvertures, arêtes et jonctions sur une perspective commune. Montrer les épaisseurs de murs ou de mobilier visibles, avec une échelle cohérente. Chaque objet occupe un espace réel, sans interpénétration avec les autres.

Continuité : Conserver les personnages, accessoires et codes de couleur d’une case à l’autre. Faire varier le cadrage pour servir l’action, tout en gardant un ordre de lecture clair et des gouttières régulières.

Papier et technique : Faire interagir le médium demandé avec le support : réserve du papier, superposition des traces et densités variables. Préserver une différence entre le grain du papier et les détails représentés.

Cadrage : Placer le sujet et les éventuelles annotations avec de l’air autour. Les petites touches attirent le regard vers les éléments importants ; elles ne doivent pas remplir uniformément chaque coin de la page.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.
