original.title: Luxury Product Still Life Campaign
original.prompt:
[Product and Campaign Info]
- Appeal Text: {argument name="appeal copy" default="Exquisite & Selected"}
- Brand Copy: {argument name="brand copy" default="Lifelong leather goods created by skilled craftsmanship"}
- Target Product: {argument name="products" default="Genuine leather wallet and wristwatch"}

[Quality, Effects, and Composition]
- Style: Still-life product photography for high-end luxury brand catalogs or luxury magazine spreads.
- Subject: {argument name="products" default="Genuine leather wallet and wristwatch"} placed on deep vintage leather or high-quality dark-toned textures. Details that evoke artisanal craftsmanship (such as stitching or metal hairline finishing) are beautifully and richly depicted.
- Lighting and Color: A color palette based on deep dark brown, black, and brass gold. Warm amber-toned sidelighting with classic, heavy shadows.
- Text Placement (for GPT-image / Nano Banana Pro): Using a thin gold-colored font, the text "{argument name="appeal copy" default="Exquisite & Selected"}" and "{argument name="brand copy" default="Lifelong leather goods created by skilled craftsmanship"}" are subtly placed as typography in a calm position on the screen.

[Strict Layout and Output Constraints (Required)]
- Output the finished flat 2D design itself, filling the entire canvas. Scene elements inside the design (walls, rooms, shadows) described above are allowed. Absolutely NO photo-of-a-poster mockups: no picture frames, no poster-on-wall or poster-on-desk shots, no perspective warp or drop shadow around the artwork's edges.

- Aspect Ratio: --ar 3:4

original.title: Pop Art Style Product Advertisement
original.prompt:
[Product and Copy]
- Main Copy: {argument name="main copy" default="Ultra-lightweight, High Volume! Latest Portable Speaker"}
- Onomatopoeia: {argument name="onomatopoeia" default="BOOM!!"}
- Text inside Speech Bubble: {argument name="speech bubble" default="Awesome!"}

[Quality, Production, Composition]
- Style: Vintage pop art illustration characterized by dot (halftone) textures and strong black outlines, like the style of Roy Lichtenstein or American comics.
- Subject: A product drawn as if it were jumping out vigorously in the center. Radial lines (focus lines) spread from behind the product, enhancing the sense of dynamism.
- Typography and Speech Bubbles (for GPT-image / Nano Banana Pro): The onomatopoeia {argument name="onomatopoeia" default="BOOM!!"} is drawn in large, powerful, 3D colorful comic-style letters, and the text {argument name="speech bubble" default="Awesome!"} is placed inside a classic speech balloon. A banner for {argument name="main copy" default="Ultra-lightweight, High Volume! Latest Portable Speaker"} is designed at the top of the screen.
- Color/Tone: Vivid and high-contrast pop art colors such as yellow, red, blue, and black.

[Strict Layout and Output Constraints (Required)]
- Output the finished design itself, filling the entire screen. Backgrounds and scene descriptions (walls, spaces, shadows, etc.) within the design may follow the instructions in the main text.
- Prohibitions: Photos of the finished poster in a frame, photos pinned to a wall, mockup photos placed on a desk or paper, perspective distortion of paper edges, or drop shadows.
- Output the finished flat 2D design itself, filling the entire canvas. Scene elements inside the design (walls, rooms, shadows) described above are allowed. Absolutely NO photo-of-a-poster mockups: no picture frames, no poster-on-wall or poster-on-desk shots, no perspective warp or drop shadow around the artwork's edges.

original.prompt:
{
  "image_generation_request": {
    "subject_configuration": {
      "placeholder": "{argument name=\"product name\" default=\"[INSERT_PRODUCT_HERE]\"}",

      "presentation": "levitating_in_void",
      "composition_rules": [

        "no_cropping",

        "subject_must_be_contained_within_frame_safety_margins"

      "background_color": "#000000",
      "lighting_style": "dramatic_rim_lighting",
      "primary_glow_color": "{argument name=\"primary glow color\" default=\"#FF4500\"}",
      "accent_lighting": "mechanical_internal_luminescence",
      "surface_textures": [
        "anodized_black_metal",
        "iridescent_glass_reflections",
        "crystalline_transparency",
        "carbon_fiber_matte"
      ]
    },
    "visual_effects": {
      "style_blend": "Hyper-realistic_Industrial_Design",
      "mechanical_detail": "macro_lens_precision",
      "atmosphere": "clean_vacuum_void"
    },
    "negative_constraints": {
      "prohibited_elements": [
        "text",
        "typography",
        "logos",
        "watermarks",
        "pedestals",
        "stands",
        "mounting_brackets",
        "visible_light_boxes",
        "softbox_reflections",
        "studio_props",
        "background_gradients",
        "floor_planes",
        "shadow_casting_on_surfaces"
      ],
      "framing_errors": [
        "cut_off_edges",
        "zoomed_in",
        "partial_view",
        "off-center"
      ]
    },
    "color_palette_specification": {
      "base": "#000000",
      "highlight_orange": "#FF5E00",
      "amber_glow": "#CC4400",
      "steel_accent": "#A8A8A8"
    }
  }
}

entries.title: Cosmic Product Photography: Futuristic Energy Serum
entries.prompt:
High-end cosmic premium product photography of a futuristic energy-balancing serum titled “{argument name="product name" default="PulseCharge Serum"}”, visualized as an advanced bio-tech concept launch.

BOTTLE DESIGN:
Tall, streamlined bottle with concentric alloy rings appearing magnetically aligned around the body. Frosted high-density glass with carbon-pattern polymer grip bands.

LIQUID:
Intense cobalt-red liquid with crystalline micro-structures suspended within, representing kinetic energy and bioelectric activation.

TYPOGRAPHY (PRINTED ON BOTTLE):
Matte white ink, technical precision typography:
- ELECTRO BALANCE SYSTEM
- CODE: PC-61
- OUTPUT: 980J

BACKGROUND:
Soft steel-blue pastel background, minimal and cool-toned, complementing the vivid red liquid.

LIGHTING:
Clean high-contrast lighting with sharp electric reflections on metal surfaces. Luminous liquid core with controlled highlights.

PHOTOGRAPHY:
100mm macro lens, 8K resolution, hyper-realistic detail, razor-sharp textures, shallow depth of field.

OVERLAYS:
Bottom Left:
“PulseCharge Serum – Engineered to support alertness, balance, and sustained internal energy.”

Bottom Right:
Minimal lightning-line logomark in dark neutral gray.

MOOD:
Electric, engineered, futuristic, precision-driven.

NEGATIVE PROMPTS:
No clutter, no people, no lens flares, no cyberpunk exaggeration, no noise, no text distortion.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Cosmic Product Photography: Futuristic Energy Serum
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Forme et fonction : Montrer une silhouette exploitable et des épaisseurs plausibles. Soigner les jonctions, coutures, fermetures, ouvertures ou commandes réellement présentes ; chaque détail doit avoir une place logique sur l’objet.

Présentation : Faire lire le produit avant ses accessoires. Préserver les arêtes et la face principale, avec des ombres de contact qui expliquent son appui. Les reflets révèlent les volumes sans cacher les détails ni les mentions fournies.

Matériaux : Distinguer les propriétés des surfaces : rugosité, transparence, métal, fibres ou enduit. Garder une échelle de grain cohérente avec la taille du produit et éviter la même brillance sur tous les composants.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

  "request": {

      "background": "seamless solid #59925C background with no floor, surface, pedestal, platform, table, shadow ground, or horizon line — the product floats against a uniform single-color field",
      "grounding": "no visible ground plane, no reflective surface beneath the product"
    },
    "rendering_details": {
      "transparency": "multi-layered refraction with thin-film interference",
      "finish": "polished edges with subtle holographic light dispersion",
      "hardware_detail": "macro-precision on hex-head bolt sockets",

      "layer_separation": "each glass panel must be visibly separated with clear air gaps — not fused or touching — bolts are the only element connecting the layers"
    }

}

A realistic first-person perspective (POV) shot of a person's hands holding a bunch of fresh, red strawberries in a blurred supermarket aisle. The image features a futuristic Augmented Reality (AR) interface overlay. 

Glowing holographic graphics surround the strawberries displaying nutritional information like 'Calories {argument name="calories" default="50kcal"}', 'Vitamin C', 'Folate', and 'Fiber'. On the right, a digital gauge shows 'Freshness {argument name="freshness" default="95%"}' and recipe suggestions like 'Strawberry Smoothie'. On the left, a holographic shopping list checks off items like Milk and Bread. 

High-tech, smart shopping concept, photorealistic lighting, 8k resolution.

original.title: Isometric 3D Tony Stark Workshop Cube
original.prompt:
An isometric 3D cube-shaped miniature room (perfect shallow cutaway cube, everything 100% strictly contained inside the cube boundary, no protrusion).  

Room description: Tony Stark's underground workshop during the Iron Man Mark 42 suit autonomous assembly process. Dimly lit high-tech garage lab: brushed steel and matte black walls covered with holographic blueprints, arc reactor glow, scattered tools (DUM-E robotic arm holding a coffee mug, U robotic arm spraying fire extinguisher), multiple half-assembled red-gold Iron Man suits hanging on robotic arms, a central rotating platform where the Mark 42 suit pieces are flying and auto-assembling onto a dummy Tony, sparks flying, welding arms active, floor littered with micro thrusters, faceplates, repulsor parts, empty whiskey glasses, and a glowing circular arc reactor prototype on the workbench. Wall has a large "Stark Industries" logo and Jarvis interface screens showing suit diagnostics.

Character: chibi/figurine-style Tony Stark in black tank top, perfectly groomed goatee, matte PVC material, big head small body proportion, standing on the workbench with arms outstretched, confidently directing the autonomous suit pieces to assemble around the dummy, cocky satisfied smirk, one eyebrow raised, wearing welding goggles pushed up on forehead.

Lighting: dramatic cinematic workshop atmosphere (cold blue holographic glow from screens + intense white welding sparks + signature arc reactor ice-blue light + warm orange workshop lamps), realistic metallic reflections, colored caustics and god rays cutting through light smoke.

Camera: slightly elevated isometric three-quarter view, front edge of the cube perfectly centered and framed, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp, background softly blurred, photorealistic materials, ultra-high detail on every screw and reflection, clean museum-like composition, neutral dark backdrop, no text, no watermark, no elements outside the cube.

8K, masterpiece, best quality, Gemini 3 Pro Nano Banana Pro style

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Isometric 3D Tony Stark Workshop Cube
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Lecture finale : Préserver les zones utiles sur les bords et éviter les commandes collées au sujet. Si du texte ou des valeurs sont fournis, les reproduire exactement ; ne pas ajouter de fausse télémétrie ni de microtexte illisible.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

Proportions : Vérifier les rapports de taille entre sujet, accessoires et environnement. Les changements de profondeur expliquent les différences de taille ; éviter des éléments secondaires anormalement grands ou des détails sans épaisseur.

Cohérence chromatique : Utiliser la palette indiquée dans le brief avec des variations de valeur et de saturation. Éviter d’introduire une couleur dominante supplémentaire ; les accents servent à distinguer le sujet ou une information précise.

original.title: Vast Open-World Game Environment Generator

Let the terrain, colors, surface forms and horizon geometry emerge naturally from [THEME] without explicit constraints.

Compose the scene to feel like a high-budget open-world game vista rather than a photograph.
Ensure the final image feels serene, epic and discovery-driven, clearly readable as a game world shaped by [THEME].

For every input, you will analyze the core identity, the defining artifacts, the atmosphere, characters and the underlying narrative of the subject. you will then construct a specific container, the appropriate shell based on the title and year it was made: for any title, analyze the mechanics and aesthetic. visualize a hollowed-out item. the interior is a diorama of a famous level or scene. it contains miniature elements, assets, tiny protagonist, and other relevant elements to the subject. lighting & style should be appropriate for the title </instructions>

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Game/Book Diorama Concept Generator
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Hiérarchie fonctionnelle : Séparer zone de jeu ou contenu principal, commandes et informations secondaires. Utiliser des alignements, espacements et tailles cohérents ; le regard doit reconnaître immédiatement l’action ou l’information prioritaire.

Échelle miniature : Conserver une direction de projection commune et une échelle constante entre objets. Faire lire le support et la séparation des plans ; garder les petits détails suffisamment simples pour éviter un effet de maquette brouillée.

Pages et reliure : Rendre lisibles les tranches, la charnière et les pages comme des surfaces distinctes. Si un monde émerge du livre, assurer une transition claire entre papier et scène, avec des ombres de contact cohérentes.

original.title: Chibi RPG Game Campaign Key Visual
original.prompt:
[Game Campaign]
- Game Title: {argument name="game title" default="Treasure Hunt!"}
- Game Overview/Features: {argument name="description" default="Find treasures on a great adventure island!"}
- Genre/Subtext: {argument name="subtext" default="RPG Adventure Action!"}

[Quality, Production, Composition]
- Style: Illustration for event announcements for Japanese mobile RPGs or casual games. A colorful and joyful fantasy world.
- Subject: Adorable chibi characters (deformed heroes or mascots) opening a treasure chest with smiles. Golden light and magical particles are overflowing dazzlingly from the chest.
- Background: Blue sky, white clouds, and islands or forests in a lush fantasy world.
- Typography (for GPT-image / Nano Banana Pro): A fantasy-style decorative logotype of {argument name="game title" default="Treasure Hunt!"} is designed in the center or top of the screen, with {argument name="description" default="Find treasures on a great adventure island!"} and {argument name="subtext" default="RPG Adventure Action!"} added in an easy-to-read layout.
- Color/Lighting: Bright, high-saturation fantasy colors, magical gloss, and soft shadow depiction.

[Strict Layout and Output Constraints (Required)]
- Output the finished design itself, filling the entire screen. Backgrounds and scene descriptions (walls, spaces, shadows, etc.) within the design may follow the instructions in the main text.
- Prohibitions: Photos of the finished poster in a frame, photos pinned to a wall, mockup photos placed on a desk or paper, perspective distortion of paper edges, or drop shadows.
- Output the finished flat 2D design itself, filling the entire canvas. Scene elements inside the design (walls, rooms, shadows) described above are allowed. Absolutely NO photo-of-a-poster mockups: no picture frames, no poster-on-wall or poster-on-desk shots, no perspective warp or drop shadow around the artwork's edges.

- Aspect Ratio: --ar 16:9

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Chibi RPG Game Campaign Key Visual
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Hiérarchie fonctionnelle : Séparer zone de jeu ou contenu principal, commandes et informations secondaires. Utiliser des alignements, espacements et tailles cohérents ; le regard doit reconnaître immédiatement l’action ou l’information prioritaire.

Personnage miniature : Conserver une silhouette immédiatement identifiable malgré la simplification. Distinguer vêtements, visage et accessoires par des formes nettes ; les petits éléments gardent une épaisseur de fabrication plausible et ne fusionnent pas avec le corps.

Cohérence du monde : Accorder les matériaux, la palette et les signes graphiques à l’univers décrit. Pour une interface, répéter les mêmes règles de boutons et pictogrammes ; pour un objet de jeu, rendre compréhensibles silhouette, prise en main et assemblage.

Lecture finale : Préserver les zones utiles sur les bords et éviter les commandes collées au sujet. Si du texte ou des valeurs sont fournis, les reproduire exactement ; ne pas ajouter de fausse télémétrie ni de microtexte illisible.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

Proportions : Vérifier les rapports de taille entre sujet, accessoires et environnement. Les changements de profondeur expliquent les différences de taille ; éviter des éléments secondaires anormalement grands ou des détails sans épaisseur.

Cohérence chromatique : Utiliser la palette indiquée dans le brief avec des variations de valeur et de saturation. Éviter d’introduire une couleur dominante supplémentaire ; les accents servent à distinguer le sujet ou une information précise.

Imagine what {argument name="subject" default="software engineers"} would do in {argument name="year" default="2050"} when all code is written by AI. {argument name="style" default="Pixel art"}.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Future AI Software Engineers Pixel Art
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

original.title: Whimsical Isometric Product Architecture Illustration
original.prompt:
A whimsical 2D flat illustration of a SINGLE giant {argument name="Product Name" default="Coca-Cola"} transformed into a bustling miniature building. The entire scene is focused on this one {argument name="Product Name" default="Coca-Cola"} structure. Architectural details like tiny windows, awnings, stairs, and neon signs are attached to its surface. Cute miniature characters and plants are interacting with the building. Isometric micro-world style, hand-drawn texture, simple solid color background with no other large objects, creative product poster

original.title: Isometric 3D Miniature City Diorama with Holiday Theme
original.prompt:
Present a clear, 45° top-down isometric 3D miniature cartoon scene, depicting the classic architecture or landmarks of [{argument name="city" default="Shanghai"}] and placing it at the center of the composition.
Use decorations, twinkling lights, and appropriate seasonal details (defaulting to Winter) corresponding to the [{argument name="holiday" default="New Year's Day"}] to depict the city as a [{argument name="holiday" default="New Year's Day"}] theme filled with festive atmosphere.
Use soft and delicate textures, realistic PBR materials, and soft, realistic lighting, creating subtle shadow effects.
Create a small, neat diorama-style city base with clean edges.
Use a clean [{argument name="holiday" default="New Year's Day"}] background color that contrasts sharply with the scene.
In the top center, display the text [{argument name="city" default="Shanghai"}] in bold, large font.
Immediately below it, display “[{argument name="holiday" default="New Year's Day"}] Special Edition” in medium font.
(Optional) Place a small square flag icon below the text.
All text must automatically match the background contrast (white or black).
Composition: Perfectly centered, 1080×1080 square, ultra-minimalist holiday diorama aesthetic

original.prompt:
{
  "image_request": {
    "format": "4-panel collage",
    "style": "Realistic portrait",
    "perspective": "High-angle shot, close to face",
    "constraints": "Face must be 100% identical across all panels",
    "subject": {
      "appearance": "Beautiful young woman with fair, smooth, flawless skin that looks healthy and naturally glowing. Shiny brown hair styled in a loose bun (messy bun). Soft, gentle makeup with flushed pink lips.",
      "accessories": [
        "Thick, large, transparent clear-frame glasses with a pink tone (clear frame 1.2)",
        "Small silver butterfly necklace"
      ],
      "clothing": "Pink T-shirt",
      "gaze": "Directly at the camera"
    },
    "lighting_and_tone": {
      "lighting_type": "Direct flash with a soft, diffused glow effect",
      "lighting_characteristics": "Flash light spreads evenly, highlights slightly overexposed, soft reflective highlights on skin",
      "color_palette": "Creamy white / creamy mauve",
      "skin_glow": "Slightly pinkish glow"
    },
    "panels": {
      "panel_1": "Sweet laughing pose",
      "panel_2": "Peace sign pose",
      "panel_3": "Metal hand sign pose",
      "panel_4": "Cute pose"
    },
    "full_prompt_text": "Create a realistic portrait image in a 4-panel collage with a high-angle shot perspective (the face must be 100% identical — do not change or modify it). Depict a beautiful young woman with fair, smooth, flawless skin that looks healthy and naturally glowing. She has shiny brown hair styled in a loose bun (messy bun). Her makeup uses soft, gentle tones, with flushed pink lips. The camera angle is close to the face. She is wearing thick, large, transparent clear-frame glasses with a pink tone (clear frame 1.2). She wears a pink T-shirt and a small silver butterfly necklace. Flash lighting illuminates the face and skin, creating soft reflective highlights and giving the skin a slightly pinkish glow. The overall color tone of the image is creamy white / creamy mauve. She looks directly at the camera. Use direct flash with a soft, diffused glow effect, where the flash light spreads evenly and the highlights are slightly overexposed. Panel 1: Sweet laughing pose. Panel 2: Peace sign pose. Panel 3: Metal hand sign pose. Panel 4: Cute pose."
  }
}

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — 4-Panel Collage Portrait with Identity Lock Prompt
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Éclairage : Rendre identifiable la direction de la source principale, sa taille apparente et sa température. La douceur des ombres et la largeur des reflets doivent découler de cette source ; garder une direction commune sur tous les objets.

Assemblage en papier : Rendre visibles l’épaisseur des feuilles, les plis et les chevauchements. Les couches projettent de petites ombres cohérentes ; conserver des découpes franches et des silhouettes simples, sans simuler du plastique ou du métal.

Visage : Préserver les proportions, l’expression et les traits distinctifs du visage de référence. Rendre les yeux et leur orientation cohérents, conserver des textures naturelles et éviter les dents, doigts ou contours d’oreille déformés.

Exposition : Conserver de l’information dans les parties importantes des hautes lumières et des ombres. Hiérarchiser le contraste pour que le sujet se détache du fond ; éviter les halos artificiels sur les contours.

Prise de vue : Conserver un cadrage intentionnel et une profondeur de champ compatible avec la scène. La netteté maximale se trouve sur le détail principal, avec des transitions progressives vers les autres plans.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

Proportions : Vérifier les rapports de taille entre sujet, accessoires et environnement. Les changements de profondeur expliquent les différences de taille ; éviter des éléments secondaires anormalement grands ou des détails sans épaisseur.

Cohérence chromatique : Utiliser la palette indiquée dans le brief avec des variations de valeur et de saturation. Éviter d’introduire une couleur dominante supplémentaire ; les accents servent à distinguer le sujet ou une information précise.

original.title: Ultra-Premium Cinematic 3D Brand Advertisement Prompt for Nano Banana Pro
original.prompt:
Create a breathtaking ultra-premium cinematic 3D brand advertisement masterpiece in Nano Banana Pro style, hyper-detailed and perfectly polished.

One charismatic stylized heroic main character as the absolute star of the image, confidently standing or dramatically posed on top of one gigantic oversized hero product object inspired by {argument name="brand name" default="TYPE BRAND NAME"}. The hero product must be massively scaled, extremely dominant in the frame, instantly readable as the powerful central visual statement, with intricate surface details and premium material realism.

Extreme minimalism with massive negative space, perfect visual hierarchy, and clean centered composition. Dramatic low-angle hero perspective that makes everything feel epic and aspirational.

Sophisticated clean background using the exact official {argument name="brand color palette" default="BRAND"} color palette, identity, and aesthetic.

Show the official {argument name="brand logo" default="BRAND"} logo only once, perfectly integrated in an elegant position (never repeated). If no logo file is provided, generate the latest accurate official logo version. Place one powerful elegant 3-word slogan right next to the logo, rendered with flawless brand-authentic typography, perfect kerning, spacing, proportion, and premium visual treatment.

Ultra-premium 3D animation render style mixed with Unreal Engine 5 and Octane quality, dramatic cinematic commercial lighting with beautiful rim lights, soft volumetric god rays, subtle lens flare, and high-contrast mood. Razor-sharp 8K details, perfect focus, luxurious aspirational atmosphere, strong negative space, no clutter whatsoever, no extra text, no watermark.

Masterpiece, best quality, commercial campaign level, award-winning visual.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Ultra-Premium Cinematic 3D Brand Advertisement Prompt for Nano Banana Pro
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Système graphique : Utiliser une grille, des alignements et des marges communs. Distinguer signe principal, nom et informations secondaires. Garder des espacements réguliers et une silhouette de marque lisible en petit, sans ajouter de symboles concurrents.

Hiérarchie éditoriale : Faire lire d’abord le titre exact demandé, puis le sujet, puis les informations secondaires prévues. Préserver les bords de coupe et les espaces de respiration. Éviter les faux crédits, les dates ou les logos ajoutés automatiquement.

Signe et reproduction : Faire fonctionner la silhouette à petite taille, avec des contreformes dégagées et des espacements réguliers. Si le signe devient un objet, conserver sa géométrie et montrer sa matière sans ajouter de détails qui en changent la lecture.

Déclinaisons : Si plusieurs supports sont demandés, répéter les mêmes proportions du signe, couleurs et règles typographiques. Adapter la surface imprimée à chaque support ; distinguer le graphisme plat de la perspective du mockup.

Lisibilité : Reproduire exactement les mots fournis. Préserver les contreformes, accents et espacements. Ne pas inventer de promesse commerciale, certification ou label ; les petits textes manquants restent des zones de mise en page.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

original.title: Futuristic Creator Brand Campaign
original.prompt:
A hyper-realistic futuristic creator-brand campaign poster featuring a stylish young digital creator standing confidently in the middle of a {argument name="setting" default="modern luxury studio space"} with cinematic lighting, glossy reflective floors, floating holographic UI graphics, and premium fashion-editorial aesthetics. The environment should feel like a futuristic content-creator headquarters mixed with a luxury fashion campaign and modern AI-tech branding studio. Include large LED panels, ambient blue lighting, reflective metallic textures, floating interface visuals, glowing screens, and subtle cinematic haze. The subject wears a fully customizable high-end creator-fashion outfit: oversized bomber jacket, layered hoodie, fitted tee, stacked cargos, designer sneakers, chains, rings, watches, or {argument name="style" default="futuristic streetwear styling"}. Clothing textures must look ultra-realistic with visible stitching, premium fabrics, natural folds, and sharp detailing. The outfit includes customizable creator-brand typography and logos based on the {argument name="identity" default="user’s chosen name"}. Branding should appear professionally integrated as: embroidered chest logos, sleeve patches, stitched fashion labels, back-print graphics, luxury creator-brand typography. Typography must be: perfectly readable, professionally aligned, clean luxury design, ultra-sharp, realistic printed or embroidered text, no blurry AI-generated lettering. Composition: The creator stands center-frame while layered digital collage elements float around the composition: glassmorphism interface cards, floating notifications, upload progress bars, social-media widgets, futuristic dashboard panels, holographic app windows, rounded UI elements, creator analytics graphics, clean digital overlays. Pose & Expression: Relaxed confident body language with subtle movement. One hand adjusting clothing or accessories while maintaining a naturally cool creator presence. Expression: focused, stylish, calm confidence with realistic facial detail and authentic social-media personality energy. Lighting: cinematic studio lighting, soft blue ambient glow, realistic flash highlights, reflective floor lighting, dramatic shadows, subtle film grain, ultra-detailed skin texture, editorial-quality realism. Overall Mood: Futuristic, premium, stylish, internet-native, cinematic, creator-focused, luxury-tech aesthetic with viral campaign energy. Image Quality: Ultra-realistic photography, extremely detailed textures, sharp focus, cinematic color grading, realistic reflections, professional campaign quality, high-resolution fashion-editorial realism. Negative Prompt: bad anatomy, blurry text, unreadable typography, distorted hands, extra fingers, warped reflections, low-detail clothing, messy composition, fake UI text, cartoon rendering, low realism, duplicate subjects, broken perspective.

Déclinaisons : Si plusieurs supports sont demandés, répéter les mêmes proportions du signe, couleurs et règles typographiques. Adapter la surface imprimée à chaque support ; distinguer le graphisme plat de la perspective du mockup.

Lisibilité : Reproduire exactement les mots fournis. Préserver les contreformes, accents et espacements. Ne pas inventer de promesse commerciale, certification ou label ; les petits textes manquants restent des zones de mise en page.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

Proportions : Vérifier les rapports de taille entre sujet, accessoires et environnement. Les changements de profondeur expliquent les différences de taille ; éviter des éléments secondaires anormalement grands ou des détails sans épaisseur.

Priorités : Les quantités, couleurs, mots exacts, proportions et éléments imposés dans la demande initiale priment sur les conseils de finition. Résoudre les ambiguïtés avec la solution qui préserve le mieux le sujet et son intention, sans accumuler de nouveaux effets.

Disposable camera aesthetic with slightly grainy texture and uneven exposure.

[Brand Concept]
- Image Concept: {argument name="concept" default="Quiet Days"}
- Shooting Location: {argument name="location" default="KOMOREBI | TOKYO"}

[Styling]
- Coordination/Outfit: {argument name="outfit" default="Linen shirt and denim"}

[Quality, Production, Composition]
- Style: Hero image for a lookbook of a minimalist, high-quality Japanese fashion and lifestyle brand.
- Subject: A model standing quietly in natural light, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="Linen shirt and denim"}. Hair swaying in the wind, wrinkles in clothing, and a quiet, natural expression.
- Background: A corridor of an old Japanese house with flickering sunlight filtering through trees, or a spot in {argument name="location" default="KOMOREBI | TOKYO"} where concrete and greenery blend beautifully.
- Lighting/Color: Soft and transparent sunlight in the morning or evening, faint and beautiful earth tones with low contrast (nuance gray, olive, natural beige).
- Typography (for GPT-image / Nano Banana Pro): The words {argument name="concept" default="Quiet Days"} and {argument name="location" default="KOMOREBI | TOKYO"} are quietly arranged in the white space of the screen in an ultra-fine, modern sans-serif font.

[Strict Layout and Output Constraints (Required)]
- Output the finished design itself, filling the entire screen. Backgrounds and scene descriptions (walls, spaces, shadows, etc.) within the design may follow the instructions in the main text.
- Prohibitions: Photos of the finished poster in a frame, photos pinned to a wall, mockup photos placed on a desk or paper, perspective distortion of paper edges, or drop shadows.
- Output the finished flat 2D design itself, filling the entire canvas. Scene elements inside the design (walls, rooms, shadows) described above are allowed. Absolutely NO photo-of-a-poster mockups: no picture frames, no poster-on-wall or poster-on-desk shots, no perspective warp or drop shadow around the artwork's edges.

- Aspect Ratio: --ar 16:9

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Fashion Brand Lookbook Editorial Portrait
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Système graphique : Utiliser une grille, des alignements et des marges communs. Distinguer signe principal, nom et informations secondaires. Garder des espacements réguliers et une silhouette de marque lisible en petit, sans ajouter de symboles concurrents.

Visage : Préserver les proportions, l’expression et les traits distinctifs du visage de référence. Rendre les yeux et leur orientation cohérents, conserver des textures naturelles et éviter les dents, doigts ou contours d’oreille déformés.

Signe et reproduction : Faire fonctionner la silhouette à petite taille, avec des contreformes dégagées et des espacements réguliers. Si le signe devient un objet, conserver sa géométrie et montrer sa matière sans ajouter de détails qui en changent la lecture.

Pages et reliure : Rendre lisibles les tranches, la charnière et les pages comme des surfaces distinctes. Si un monde émerge du livre, assurer une transition claire entre papier et scène, avec des ombres de contact cohérentes.

Déclinaisons : Si plusieurs supports sont demandés, répéter les mêmes proportions du signe, couleurs et règles typographiques. Adapter la surface imprimée à chaque support ; distinguer le graphisme plat de la perspective du mockup.

Lisibilité : Reproduire exactement les mots fournis. Préserver les contreformes, accents et espacements. Ne pas inventer de promesse commerciale, certification ou label ; les petits textes manquants restent des zones de mise en page.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

original.title: Nine Moods Grid Portrait with Identity Lock
original.prompt:
{
  "image_prompt": {
    "critical_instruction": "Maintain identical facial structure across all panels. The identity must be unmistakable in every single shot.",
    "format": "3x3 grid collage",
    "subject": {
      "face_identity_lock": "fixed identity, consistent facial features",
      "style": "hyper-realistic portrait photography, 8k resolution, raw photo aesthetic",
      "skin": "highly detailed natural skin texture, visible pores, realistic complexion",
      "camera_settings": "shot on 85mm portrait lens, sharp focus on eyes, shallow depth of field, studio photography"
    },
    "panels": [
      {
        "position": "top_left",
        "expression": "joyful",
        "pose": "bright smile, hands slightly raised framing the face",
        "hairstyle": "high ponytail with loose front strands",
        "outfit": "pastel tie-dye hoodie",
        "background": "light blue studio backdrop"
      },
      {
        "position": "top_middle",
        "expression": "surprised",
        "pose": "mouth open, hands touching cheeks",
        "hairstyle": "long loose wavy hair",
        "outfit": "beige t-shirt",
        "background": "peach studio backdrop"
      },
      {
        "position": "top_right",
        "expression": "sad",
        "pose": "looking down slightly, hand resting on chin",
        "hairstyle": "messy updo",
        "outfit": "grey knit sweater",
        "background": "muted lavender studio backdrop"
      },
      {
        "position": "middle_left",
        "expression": "tender",
        "pose": "gentle smile, looking directly at camera",
        "hairstyle": "elegant half-up half-down hairstyle",
        "outfit": "cream v-neck top",
        "background": "tan studio backdrop"
      },
      {
        "position": "center",
        "expression": "daring",
        "pose": "confident stare, chin slightly lowered",
        "hairstyle": "slicked-back wet-look hair",
        "outfit": "black leather moto jacket",
        "background": "deep teal studio backdrop"
      },
      {
        "position": "middle_right",
        "expression": "playful",
        "pose": "scrunched nose, quirky smirk",
        "hairstyle": "short curly bob",
        "outfit": "blue and white striped button-down shirt",
        "background": "mint green studio backdrop"
      },
      {
        "position": "bottom_left",
        "expression": "charming",
        "pose": "winking, finger poking right cheek",
        "hairstyle": "double space buns",
        "outfit": "dark grey graphic tee",
        "background": "light pink studio backdrop"
      },
      {
        "position": "bottom_middle",
        "expression": "shocked",
        "pose": "mouth open in disbelief, hands gripping hair",
        "hairstyle": "messy voluminous loose hair",
        "outfit": "white button-down blouse",
        "background": "pale yellow studio"
      }
    ]
  }
}

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Nine Moods Grid Portrait with Identity Lock
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Éclairage : Rendre identifiable la direction de la source principale, sa taille apparente et sa température. La douceur des ombres et la largeur des reflets doivent découler de cette source ; garder une direction commune sur tous les objets.

Visage : Préserver les proportions, l’expression et les traits distinctifs du visage de référence. Rendre les yeux et leur orientation cohérents, conserver des textures naturelles et éviter les dents, doigts ou contours d’oreille déformés.

Exposition : Conserver de l’information dans les parties importantes des hautes lumières et des ombres. Hiérarchiser le contraste pour que le sujet se détache du fond ; éviter les halos artificiels sur les contours.

Prise de vue : Conserver un cadrage intentionnel et une profondeur de champ compatible avec la scène. La netteté maximale se trouve sur le détail principal, avec des transitions progressives vers les autres plans.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

Bords et superpositions : Contrôler chaque chevauchement : l’élément situé devant masque correctement celui qui est derrière. Les contours ne doivent pas se fondre involontairement ; préserver les petits espaces négatifs qui aident à comprendre les formes.

Proportions : Vérifier les rapports de taille entre sujet, accessoires et environnement. Les changements de profondeur expliquent les différences de taille ; éviter des éléments secondaires anormalement grands ou des détails sans épaisseur.

Cohérence chromatique : Utiliser la palette indiquée dans le brief avec des variations de valeur et de saturation. Éviter d’introduire une couleur dominante supplémentaire ; les accents servent à distinguer le sujet ou une information précise.

Qualité des contours : Adapter la netteté au médium : une limite découpée, un bord de peinture et un contour photographique ne se traitent pas de la même façon. Éviter la suraccentuation, les franges lumineuses et les doubles contours.

Équilibre : Répartir les masses visuelles de manière intentionnelle et laisser des espaces de respiration. Ne pas déplacer le sujet principal pour combler un vide utile ; contrôler l’image en réduction pour vérifier qu’elle reste compréhensible.

Sortie : Livrer uniquement le visuel demandé, dans le format prévu, sans cadre de présentation, interface logicielle, filigrane ou texte additionnel non demandé. Si un élément ne peut pas être déduit du brief, ne pas inventer de donnée factuelle pour le remplacer.

Priorités : Les quantités, couleurs, mots exacts, proportions et éléments imposés dans la demande initiale priment sur les conseils de finition. Résoudre les ambiguïtés avec la solution qui préserve le mieux le sujet et son intention, sans accumuler de nouveaux effets.

original.title: Luxury Black and Gold Korean Brand Identity Collage
original.prompt:
Luxury brand identity presentation, premium product branding collage, central hero with orbital panels arrangement, black and gold aesthetic, brand touchpoints showcase. Center: A Korean woman in a modernized black silk hanbok, gold embroidery, jeweled norigae. Orbital panels: Close-ups of hanbok details (silk texture, embroidery), gold jewelry (hairpins, rings), packaging (black lacquer box, gold foil lettering), cosmetics (cushion compact, lipstick), lifestyle shots (woman in hanbok at a traditional Korean tea ceremony, calligraphy demonstration), brand logo (stylized Korean script), pattern detail (geometric bojagi). Black background, gold accents, traditional Korean patterns. High-end commercial product photography, studio lighting, Hasselblad X2D, 85mm f/1.2. Style: heritage meets modern, sophisticated, black and gold aesthetic.. A stylish handwritten signature {argument name="signature name" default="Willy"} is elegantly and small letters placed at the Bottom Right corner.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Luxury Black and Gold Korean Brand Identity Collage
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Cell 6 (Calendar): A desk calendar showing a monthly view with themed illustrations or photos related to "{argument name="content" default="beauty"}" and brand branding on each page.
All items across all six cells consistently apply the logo, color scheme, typography, and graphic elements of the "{argument name="content" default="beauty"}" brand identity. The background behind the grid is a clean, neutral grey studio wall. 4k resolution, highly detailed texture.

A surreal, high-fashion advertisement featuring a smiling woman with long wavy hair sitting comfortably atop a giant, 3D metallic brushed-steel Puma logo. The logo is floating high above a vast, fluffy sea of clouds during a golden hour sunset. The woman is wearing a clean white tracksuit and vibrant orange sneakers with reflective sunglasses. The lighting is ethereal and cinematic, with soft sunlight hitting the clouds and creating a warm glow. Hyper-realistic, 8k resolution, sleek commercial photography style.

Idée centrale : Rendre la transformation ou la rencontre inhabituelle immédiatement compréhensible. Choisir un point focal net et organiser les éléments secondaires pour expliquer cette idée, plutôt que multiplier les surprises sans lien entre elles.

original.title: Stylized Collectible Toy Packaging
original.prompt:
Transform the {argument name="subject" default="character"} into a stylized collectible toy with glossy plastic textures, exaggerated features, miniature accessories, and premium blister-pack retail packaging with a cardboard backer.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Stylized Collectible Toy Packaging
Ces précisions complètent le prompt original ; ses contraintes explicites restent prioritaires.

Silhouette et pose : Séparer clairement la tête, le torse et les membres par leur silhouette. Donner au personnage une posture stable et une expression intentionnelle ; les accessoires doivent rester reconnaissables sans masquer le visage. Respecter les proportions du style demandé.

Contenant : Définir clairement bouchon ou ouverture, épaisseur, étiquette et jonction des matériaux. La typographie fournie suit le support sans déformation excessive. Les reflets mettent en valeur les volumes et la lisibilité de la face principale.

Volume et contact : Montrer les points d’appui, les jonctions des vêtements et l’épaisseur des petits accessoires. Les ombres de contact relient les pièces au corps et le personnage à son support ; éviter les membres fusionnés et les éléments flottants accidentels.

original.prompt:
Split-screen cinematic composition featuring Batman, divided vertically into two distinct halves.

Left Side – Technical Blueprint Panel

Highly detailed Batman suit technical blueprint, inspired by aerospace and military engineering schematics.
Black ink line art on an off-white blueprint background.

The blueprint shows labeled components and exploded views, including:

Batman cowl side

Chest armor plating and core power system

Utility belt modules and gadgets

Gauntlets with grappling launcher and blade details

Boots with reinforced armor and mobility systems

Cape attachment system and gliding mechanics

Shoulder armor plates and articulation points

Back-mounted tech housing grounded realism

Precise measurements, arrows, technical annotations, clean drafting style, high mechanical realism.
No color fills, blueprint-style presentation, Stark-style technical clarity but Wayne Enterprises aesthetic.

Right Side – Cinematic Hyperrealistic Batman

Ultra-realistic Batman standing in a dark, moody urban environment at night, inspired by modern Batman films.
He wears a grounded, tactical Batsuit with realistic armor textures, matte black and charcoal tones, subtle wear and battle damage.

Batman stands heroically in a three-quarter pose, cape draped naturally, glowing city lights and rain-soaked atmosphere behind him.
Lighting is dramatic and cinematic, with cool blue highlights and deep shadows.
Eyes are white or dimly illuminated through the cowl, expression stoic and intimidating.

Background is a dark Gotham skyline, blurred skyscrapers, fog, and subtle rain particles.
The overall tone is gritty, grounded, realistic, and cinematic.

original.title: Artisan Toy Product Photography Prompt
original.prompt:
Subject: A high-end artisan toy, the "{argument name="toy name" default="Kál-Húf Lantern"}," a 15cm spherical object crafted from dark, polished Nordic spruce wood. The sphere features intricate, laser-etched Kúlon Séli runes that glow with internal light. In this "waking state," a soft, velvety green bioluminescent moss is emerging from the wood grain (shell.shift). Camera: 85mm macro lens, f/2.8, shallow depth of field. High-resolution product photography. Lighting: A dual-lighting setup. Primary: A sharp, high-intensity "harsh flash" from the upper left, creating deep shadows and specular highlights on the polished wood. Secondary: A soft, pulsing volumetric internal glow of emerald green and violet (tide.phase) bleeding through the runes and moss. Material: Complex PBR layering. Polished, reflective dark wood texture with visible grain, contrasting with the soft, organic "subsurface scattering" of the glowing green moss. Small crystalline ice-flecks on the surface. Composition: Central hero shot, 45-degree isometric angle. The lantern sits on a rustic, weathered wooden workbench in the Kúlon-vrékil, surrounded by out-of-focus wood shavings and silver ink-pots. Style: A fusion of Y2K Frutiger Aero (clean, glossy, tech-organic) and "Cursed Dreamcore." The background is a liminal workshop space lit by distant, blurry aurora lights.

A massive yellow crane slowly lifts the top macaron into place while smaller cranes, excavators, and dump trucks operate below on a powdered-sugar terrain.

Dreamlike but believable physics, gentle ambient motion, no abrupt cuts, seamless transitions. Lighting is studio-grade and premium:
soft diffused lighting for clean highlights
subtle rim lighting to enhance edges
gentle glow for a luxury finish
Camera: macro lens, shallow depth of field, cinematic front angle with slight push-in composition. Background softly blurred while the product remains ultra-sharp.
Style: ultra-luxury commercial beverage ad, hyper-realistic textures, 8K HDR, cinematic lighting, premium branding, vibrant yet refined aesthetic.

An open hardcover atlas lies flat, with a precision pop-up miniature of {argument name="city" default="Tokyo"} rising from a laser-cut slit across the {argument name="map region" default="Asia"} map. Landmarks {argument name="landmark 1" default="Shibuya Crossing"}, {argument name="landmark 2" default="Tokyo Tower"}, and {argument name="landmark 3" default="Sensō-ji Temple"} interlock with folded paper struts. White 3D "{argument name="title text" default="TOKYO"}" emboss/deboss blends into the pop-up platforms. Softboxes at 45° and 120°, polarized reflections, dynamic low angle, razor-sharp fold edges.

DIRECTION DÉTAILLÉE — Product photography prompt for a Tokyo pop-up atlas scene

original.title: Beach Shoreline Lifestyle Photography
original.prompt:
Ultra-realistic 8K photorealistic cinematic editorial image, 4:5 aspect ratio. A beautiful young woman MUST be walking barefoot along the shoreline on wet sand at the beach. 

Full-body framing with feet, legs, and shoes clearly visible. Body orientation slightly angled to the RIGHT relative to the camera while moving forward. Head turned to the RIGHT, head level. Gaze directed to the RIGHT at eye level. Facial expression relaxed and neutral with a soft, natural look.

She MUST be holding a pair of women’s loafers in her RIGHT hand, hanging downward naturally. LEFT arm relaxed by her side. Gentle ocean waves on the RIGHT side of the frame, shoreline stretching into the distance. Soft warm golden-hour lighting with subtle reflections on wet sand.

Outfit MUST match: lightweight {argument name="shirt type" default="white long-sleeve shirt"} with open collar and loose fit, sleeves slightly rolled; {argument name="pants type" default="beige/tan slim-fit pants"} or wide-leg trousers rolled above the ankles. Barefoot.

Accessories: sunglasses MUST be present, simple elegant wristwatch on LEFT wrist, subtle delicate bracelet on RIGHT wrist. 

Hairstyle MUST be {argument name="hair style" default="feminine and flowing, long wavy"} or straight hair gently moving in the breeze (match elegant feminine style suitable for the scene).

Environment: calm beach, soft waves, lightly clouded sky, warm natural tones. Camera angle eye-level. No cropping tighter than full body.

Hiérarchie des détails : Répartir les détails en trois niveaux : silhouette lisible de loin, caractéristiques utiles à taille normale, microtexture visible de près. Réserver les contrastes les plus forts aux informations importantes et alléger les zones secondaires.

original.title: Photorealistic Cinematic Street Romance in Istanbul Snow
original.prompt:
{
  "generation_request": {
    "meta_data": {
      "tool": "NanoBanana Pro",
      "task_type": "photoreal_candid_street_romance",
      "version": "v1.3_ISTANBUL_SNOW_SNOWMAN_LOVE_EN",
      "priority": "highest"
    },

    "output_settings": {
      "aspect_ratio": "4:5",
      "orientation": "portrait",
      "resolution_target": "ultra_high_res",
      "render_style": "ultra_photoreal_candid_street_film_still",
      "sharpness": "crisp_but_natural",
      "film_grain": "subtle_35mm",
      "color_grade": "true_to_life_winter_natural",
      "dynamic_range": "natural_not_hdr",
      "skin_rendering": "real_texture_no_retouch"
    },

    "global_rules": {
      "camera_language": "35mm lens equivalent, eye-level, imperfect framing, candid documentary feel, focus on eyes when people are present",
      "authenticity_markers": "subtle halation on snow highlights, tiny film gate weave, slight background motion blur only, real winter street texture, no studio look",
      "lighting_language": "motivated natural light only (overcast snowy daylight), deep but detailed shadows"
    },

    "creative_prompt": {
      "scene_summary": "{argument name="scene summary" default="Istanbul during a snowy day. A young couple in their early 20s builds a snowman together while snow continues to fall. A quiet, candid moment of shared joy—love without performance."}",

      "subjects": {
        "count": 2,
        "description": "the same young man and woman (early 20s), university students, ordinary and real, not model-like; faces visible and eyes sharp",
        "expression": "soft laughter, concentration, shy happiness; restrained and natural",
        "skin_and_face": "natural skin texture, slightly reddened cheeks from cold, no beauty retouch, no plastic skin"
      },

      "wardrobe_and_props": {
        "female": "simple winter coat in neutral tone, scarf loosely wrapped, gloves slightly wet from snow, long hair partially tucked into coat",
        "male": "dark winter jacket, knit sweater underneath, simple jeans, gloves in hand or worn",
        "props": "partially built snowman between them, snow clinging to sleeves and hair"
      },

      "micro_action": "they roll snow together, hands brushing accidentally; one adjusts the snowman’s head while the other laughs; snowflakes collect on shoulders and eyelashes",

      "environment_details": {
        "location": "Istanbul neighborhood street or park ({argument name="location vibe" default="Moda / Kuzguncuk / university surroundings vibe"})",
        "background": "old apartment facades dusted with snow, parked cars lightly covered, bare tree branches, a few distant passersby softly blurred",
        "ground_details": "fresh snow underfoot, uneven footprints, slushy edges near the pavement"
      },

      "lighting": "soft overcast winter daylight, diffused by snowfall; gentle contrast; subtle halation on bright snow surfaces",

      "composition": "eye-level medium shot, slightly off-center framing, imperfect crop like real street ph"
    }
  }
}
